686923970.name: HRV4Training
686923970.description: The first scientifically validated Heart Rate Variability (HRV) app. HRV4Training provides HRV based insights to help you quantify stress, better balance training and lifestyle, and improve performance. HRV4Training does not require a heart rate monitor, since it can accurately assess your HRV using the phone's camera. HRV4Training also works with Apple Watch, the Oura ring and all compatible Bluetooth SMART sensors. HRV4Training is also the first app that goes beyond simple measurements and provides insights on: 1) acute or day to day HRV changes in response to different stressors (alcohol, travel, sick days, training, menstruation, etc.) 2) long term multi-parameter trends to look at the big picture 3) correlations between physiological measurements and annotations 4) training load analysis, fitness, fatigue, readiness to perform and injury risk 5) VO2max estimation for runners linking the app to Strava or TrainingPeaks and using a heart rate monitor during their workouts 6) Training Polarization analysis (or 80/20) 7) Lactate Threshold Estimation for runners linking the app to Strava or TrainingPeaks and using a heart rate monitor during their workouts 8) Weekly and monthly summaries to track progress. All data is processed inside the app in order to provide you with actionable interpretations that can help optimizing your training plan and performance. Supported devices for the camera measurement: iPhones 5, 5S, 6, 6S, 6+, 6S+, SE, 7, 7+, 8, 8+, X, XS, XS Max, XR, 11, 11 Pro, 11 Pro Max, 12 mini, 12, 12 Pro, 12 Pro Max, 13 mini, 13, 13 Pro, 13 Pro Max, 14, 14 Plus, 14 Max, 14 Pro, 15, 15 Max, 15 Pro, 16, 16 Max, 16 Pro Currently unsupported devices for the camera measurement: iPhones 4S, iPads and iPods - These devices require a chest strap. Other features: HRV-based advice helps you to adapt your trainings based on objective measures of recovery TAGS: lets you tag your sleep, mental energy, muscle fatigue, stress and all other parameters that can help you understand what is influencing your physical condition and physiological stress Works with Bluetooth SMART heart rate monitors (a Polar H7 is recommended) or simply your phone's Camera Integrates with the Health app (writes heart rate, and sleep, read sleep time) Configurable test (single or orthostatic, choose test duration between 1, 3 or 5 minutes) Extracts and stores the following features while lying down and/or standing: heart rate, mean of beat-to-beat intervals (AVNN), standard deviation of beat-to-beat intervals (SDNN), square root of the mean squared difference of successive R-Rs (rMSSD), number of pairs of successive R-Rs that differ by more than 50 ms (pNN50), low frequency power (LF, 0.04-0.15 Hz), high frequency power (HF, 0.15-0.40 Hz) Shows the PPG signal view to ensure signal quality during the test if the camera is used instead of a bluetooth SMART sensor HRV4T Recovery Points to provide a single, straightforward metric to analyze your physical condition Population summaries and people like you comparisons to put your data into perspective Analysis of compliance and consistency Data export via email or Dropbox Integrates with TrainingPeaks, Oura, Strava and Coros HRV4Training requires to register an account with your email address, so that your data can be backed up safely and retrieved in case anything happens (app issue, changing phone, etc.). HRV4Training does not provide medical advice. It is intended for informational purposes only. Consult a medical professional before making health or lifestyle decisions. Please find an overview of the relevant scientific literature in our guide, here: https://marcoaltini.substack.com/p/the-ultimate-guide-to-heart-rate

687387128.name: John Scott Yoga
687387128.description: John Scott Yoga is John's first foray into spreading his teaching and knowledge of the Ashtanga Vinyasa Yoga in the form of a digital App The source material comes with Jonny's official approval and combines his existing DVD material and teacher training course notes in a new and portable format. The application focuses on the Vinyasa Count, the mantra of the Ashtanga practice, with Jonny's instructional audio track playing over images from his highly acclaimed Ashtanga DVD This Universal Application features:- Video introduction to the Ashtanga Practice Primary Series vinyasa count from the Internationally acclaimed John Scott Primary Series DVD Audio Teaching chant with John - Updated versions of the Practice and Closing Mantras with Jonny and as call and response Vinyasa Count Quiz with 8 levels of difficulty Quiz breakdown to assist with directing your learning Inspirational Videos Sanskrit numbers and terms Embedded and online help and support Audio scrubbing for quick access to instructional information Asana details from Jonny's teacher training course notes Access to Jonny's online website Access to Jonny's Facebook page Asana Flipcards Asana states for each asana Additional In App Purchases :- Jonny's famous practice charts (now free!!) Practice Builder Windows on a Practice (full workshop transcription) 5 step Focus 12 (led meditation) This full version presents the Ashtanga Primary Series for review for existing students and as an introduction to those new to Jonny's teachings. The application is not meant as a means of learning Yoga postures though it is presented as a means to introduce the student to the details and intricacies of the Vinyasa Count. Jonny highly recommends you find the guidance of a qualified teacher to help with your practice

687421118.name: Buddhify: Guided Meditation
687421118.description: Buddhify is here to help you bring more calm, clarity and kindness to all parts of your life. Whether you're looking to reduce stress and anxiety, or get a better night's sleep buddhify has easy-to-follow guided meditations to help you live happier and healthier. No need to find the time for a formal meditation session everyday, we'll show you how to bring mindfulness to all parts of your life with exercises for whatever you're doing and wherever you are - from travelling, taking a break at work or going to sleep. We'll help you find calm in any situation. WHAT'S INCLUDED? Over 200 meditations to help overcome life's challenges including anxiety, stress, sleep, pain and difficult emotions Mindfulness exercises you can do wherever you are, in categories such as travelling, at work, waking up, eating, and even when you're online Sessions for complete beginners and those with more experience, with lengths from 3-40 minutes A solo timer for more seasoned meditators A range of experienced teachers so you can choose the voice and style that's right for you Kids content for the little people in your life Brand new buddhify Membership available as an optional in-app purchase with a range of additional features for those looking to take their meditation practice further APPLE HEALTH Buddhify integrates with Apple Health so you can track your meditation using the Mindful Minutes category within the Health app. BUDDHIFY MEMBERSHIP For those of you who want to deepen your practice even further, you can do that through Buddhify Membership. Becoming a Member is optional and gives you access to three amazing features: Together, Formal and the karaoke-style Transmission. Buddhify Membership is an annual subscription and payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period and your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal. Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase. TERMS OF USE & PRIVACY You can see our terms of use at https://buddhify.com/terms-of-use/ and our privacy policy at https://buddhify.com/privacy-policy/. WHAT OTHERS ARE SAYING This app is incredible. I've been trying to get into meditation for a while now and I've found other apps or videos I've tried have been repetitive or not very good. The meditations on here are so easy to follow and the app is very user friendly. I'm always sceptical about spending money on apps but this one is so worth it. ****** I have used many meditation apps but like this one best because it offers a variety of guided meditations to use in different situations or for different purposes. They vary in the amount of time required so the app is very flexible. I also like the stats which encourage you to practice regularly. Plus I can add meditation that I do outside of the app and track that too. I highly recommend whether you are a beginner or an experienced meditator. ***** HERE TO HELP Buddhify is made by a values-led family business and we love hearing from you. Your feedback, suggestions and comments make all the hard work feel so worthwhile and makes the app better as we continue to make buddhify as effective, accessible and beautiful as it can be. Say hello@buddhify.com

687730691.name: 诗词创作器--您的诗词创作好助手
687730691.trackName: 诗词创作器--您的诗词创作好助手

687875793.name: PalpationMapp
687875793.description: PalpationMapp is an easy-to-navigate visual guide to identifying and palpating 91 essential muscles. Acclaimed author of Trail Guide to the Body, Andrew Biel provides clear instructions that will build your confidence as you practice palpating with precision. With PalpationMapp, students and practitioners in the manual therapy professionals deepen their understanding of the musculoskeletal system and master their palpation skills. Features of this app include: 91 essential muscles presented in a HD quality video format 200 beautiful overlay images from the Trail Guide to the Body textbook depict underlying anatomy during palpation Check-it box, for nearly every muscle, which helps the user confirm the location of the muscle being palpated This app teaches the user to: Identify key bony landmarks Identify and engage muscles Palpate and get a sense of fiber direction Differentiate muscles from adjacent structures Shorten and lengthen muscles Menu-guided navigation to individual palpation clips within the app is a breeze. PalpationMapp is a convenient, at-your-fingertips educational tool that will take you further on the path to mastery of palpation.

687917014.description: Mix, Swap, and Breed one photo with another! Face Mix allows you to take the face of one person and seamlessly place it on another! 687938839.name: Pocket Talkbox
687938839.description: Now you can sound like Daft Punk, Stevie Wonder, Frampton and Zapp! This is the pro version of Pocket Talkbox, featuring 6 tones, customizable scale presets, pitch bend, vibrato, and the ability to change keys up to two octaves higher or lower. If you have never used a talkbox before, be sure to watch the tutorial and try the lite version first*** HOW DOES IT WORK?!? Play a tune or a tone, pointing the speaker directly into your mouth. The SHAPE OF YOUR MOUTH creates the effect (not your voice). Start by giving the keyboard a wah-wah effect by mouthing (not speaking) "wah-wah-wah" over the speaker. PRO TIP: Point the SPEAKER (not the MICROPHONE) into your mouth while you play the notes. Move your mouth but do not use your voice! Please make an effort to understand how a talkbox works before saying it doesn't. Every musical instrument takes a certain amount of practice and this is one of them. Have fun! For additional info and full tutorials, please visit http://vbiliti.com/pockettalkbox

688128940.description: Navicat Premium 被《Database Trends and Applications》杂志选为「最佳数据库管理解决方案」***** 第一套专为 iOS 开发的完整数据库 GUI ** Navicat for MySQL 是第一套专为 iOS 开发的完整数据库管理工具，使你能够灵活地管理你的数据库。无论你现正使用 iPhone 或 iPad，Navicat 能助你摆脱你的工作站。 Navicat 拥有一套全新的功能，使你的数据库管理更为轻便和能提升使用 Navicat 的经验。同步你的连接和查询到 Navicat Cloud，或通过增强的界面的多任务处理工作流程来组织你的工作。 Navicat 与 MySQL 兼容，并具有符合专业开发人员需求的工具，但是对数据库服务器的新手来说又相当容易使用和学习。 Navicat Cloud 随时随地都能取得实时的查询和连接。 创建项目来与你的団队成员共享连接和查询。 在项目中添加成员并指派每个成员的角色。 可以从活动日志中查看你的団队活动。 简化数据编辑 在用户为中心的界面添加、修改和删除数据。 放大表以获得最佳的清晰度。 使用筛选来隔开和查找数据。 锚定和查看连接的数据库。 简化你的查询 使用我们的自动完成代码功能创建查询。 从建议列表中选择属性或 SQL 关键字。 控制你的对象 创建、修改和设计数据库对象。 预测栏位类型能根据输入预测其类型。 避免编辑复杂的 SQL。 提高工作效率 使用选项卡处理多项工作。 在单一工作区查看表和对象。 同时访问在多个不同服务器中的表和对象。 选择你的连接 通过 SSH/SSL 通道创建安全的 SSH/SSL 阶段作业。 强大验证和安全加密。 HTTP 通道能绕过互联网服务供应商的限制。 欲了解更多Navicat 的详细信息，请浏览 https://www.navicat.com.cn/products/navicat-for-mysql 任何技朮问题，请浏览 https://help.navicat.com/hc/zh-cn

688158721.name: 分享轨迹
688158721.description: 【分享轨迹】是一款功能强大的 GPS 轨迹记录与路线分享工具，非常适合 旅行、户外运动和日常出行。 使用 【分享轨迹】，您可以轻松记录自己的 GPS 轨迹、旅行路线和运动路线，并在地图上添加 照片、视频和语音记录，将每一次出行完整记录下来，与朋友分享。 无论是 徒步、骑行、跑步、驾车还是户外探险，【分享轨迹】都能帮助您捕捉每一次难忘的旅程。 让每一次旅行，都成为地图上的故事。 主要功能 GPS 轨迹记录 实时记录您的出行路线，精准追踪 GPS 数据。 记录内容包括： 距离 速度 时间 海拔 方向 适用于： 跑步 步行 骑行 徒步 自驾旅行 在地图上添加照片与视频 让您的旅行路线更加生动。 您可以在地图上的任意位置添加： 照片 视频 语音记录 文字说明 照片涂鸦 您的每一段回忆都会显示在发生的准确地点。 与朋友分享路线 轻松将您的路线分享给他人。 分享内容可以包括： GPS 轨迹 照片 视频 语音记录 朋友可以导入您的路线，在自己的地图上查看。 云端路线分享 将您的旅行路线上传到云端，与其他用户分享。 您也可以浏览和下载其他旅行者和户外爱好者分享的精彩路线。 导入与导出 GPX 路线 【分享轨迹】 支持多种路线文件格式。 您可以： 导入其他应用的 GPX 路线 导出路线用于其他地图工具 在不同导航应用中打开路线 兼容多种地图与导航平台。 路线导航 沿着记录的路线进行实时导航。 适用于： 户外探险 徒步路线 骑行路线 旅行路线 自驾游路线 智能轨迹优化 【分享轨迹】 可自动优化 GPS 轨迹，提高路线精度。 即使在长途旅行中，也能保持清晰、准确的轨迹记录。 适用人群 【分享轨迹】 非常适合： 旅行记录 徒步探险 骑行运动 跑步训练 日常出行 自驾游 户外运动 重温您的旅程 使用 【分享轨迹】，您可以随时回顾每一次旅行。 打开地图即可查看： 您走过的路线 您拍摄的照片 您记录的视频 让每一次出行，都成为一张充满回忆的地图。

688632748.name: TennisRecord
688632748.description: "Tennis Record" is score and stats management tool for all tennis players and coaches. Easily can record score, and create stats and summary that are useful to analyze your plays. Can write match summary and player stats to PDF, can share it using shared link of Dropbox, email, or open in other app. ◉Match Rules Support soft tennis Singles and doubles Support "Tie-break" Anytime can record tie-break game when the score is tie Support "No Advantage" The number of sets is upper limit to 5 The number of games is No limit and anytime can finish the set Support walkover and retirement ◉Match Score Recording Service Result (In, Ace, Winner, Out, Net, Foot Fault, Penalty) Service Placement Last Shot (Winner, Good Shot instead of forced error, Unforced Error) Shot Type (FH Stroke, BH Stroke, FH Volley, BH Volley, Smash) Stroke Type (Flat, Topspin, Slice, Drop Shot, Lob Shot) Stroke Position and Placement Unforced Error Type (Long, Wide, Net) Rally Length ◉Player Stats Can search stats under various condition (term, competition, surface, opponent) ◉Other Support multi tasking on iPad Support landscape mode (iPad only) Can add players without limit Four types of court surface image Player appears as photo image or customized wear icon Data backup to cloud storage (iCloud Drive, Dropbox, etc.)

I think you people bragging about your iq probably aren't the smartest. If you were really smart, you'd know everyone would just say your lying and not tell everyone your IQ. I think it's a good, accurate app because my sister took a really long iq test and got the exact same score." IQ Test like a Job Interview Available for iPad and iPhone. 2 different tests! And... 689675004.name: Camera Measure - PartoMeter
689675004.description: MEASURE DISTANCE AND OBJECTS WITH YOUR CAMERA – FAST, ACCURATE AND CONTACT-FREE Turn your iPhone into a powerful camera ruler, tape measure, and precision measurement tool. Measure distance, length, angles, areas, and circles directly from photos - no physical tools required. Stop guessing. Get accurate measurements in seconds. Simply place a reference object such as a credit card or sheet of paper, take a photo, and start measuring instantly. PRECISION MEASUREMENT FOR EVERY SITUATION From everyday tasks to professional use, measure anything from large outdoor objects to very small details with high accuracy. Measure distance and object size from photos Works for both large-scale and fine measurements Accurate down to sub-millimeter precision depending on conditions SMART MEASUREMENT WITH REFERENCE OBJECTS Use common items to calibrate your measurements: Credit card A4 or Letter paper CD or DVD Coins Any custom object with known size Measure large, small, distant, or hard-to-reach objects without contact. MEASUREMENT MODES Length Mode Measure distance and object size in any direction and compare multiple objects. Angle Mode Measure angles, slopes, and lengths using dual rulers. As well as for large objects that do not fit on the screen. Area Mode / Freehand Drawing Calculate the area of irregular shapes using intuitive freehand tracing. Circle Mode Measure radius, diameter, circumference, and area of circular objects. As well as for large objects that don't fit entirely in the photo. ADVANCED FEATURES Measure from saved photos Import and measure images from your gallery Zoom and edit tools for precise alignment Supports meters, centimeters, millimeters, inches, um and nm Relative measurements based on reference objects Works with high-resolution and scientific images Suitable for detailed and technical measurement tasks HOW IT WORKS Step 1: Place a reference object in the same plane as the object you want to measure Step 2: Take a photo Step 3: Align the measurement tools using zoom and editing for precise results REAL-LIFE USE CASES Measure objects and distances on scaled plans Check baggage dimensions DIY, woodworking, and crafting projects Measure large outdoor objects such as houses or trees Compare height of people Measure fabric, cloth, and surface areas Measure objects from photos, including fish or previous catches Measure mechanical parts such as bolts, nuts, and bearings Use as an angle finder or pitch gauge Measure small objects such as jewelry, screws, and insects Analyze X-ray images with a reference WHY CHOOSE THIS APP Replaces ruler, tape measure, and area calculator Measure anytime using only your phone and camera Works for both quick everyday tasks and professional applications Ease of use

690910495.name: Berenstain Bears Collection #1
690910495.description: Dive into 6 exciting Berenstain Bears interactive book apps for young readers! Explore pictures, learn new vocabulary, and personalize each story with your own narration. Enjoy The Berenstain Bears’ Bedtime Battle, The Berenstain Bears and the Big Spelling Bee, The Berenstain Bears Go on a Ghost Walk, The Berenstain Bears Hug and Make Up, The Berenstain Bears’ Really Big Pet Show, and The Berenstain Bears and the Trouble with Chores, all in one convenient place. Explore the Story: ENCOURAGE literacy skills with highlighted narration LEARN new vocabulary with tappable words and pictures RECORD your own narration & share it with others SELECT a scene with easy-to-use navigation KEEP kids in the story with parental controls Designed for children ages 4-6 The Berenstain Bears’ Bedtime Battle: Every night when the sun sets, the Berenstain Bears bedtime battle begins! Will Mama and Papa be able to get Brother and Sister all tucked away in their beds? The Berenstain Bears and the Big Spelling Bee: It's time for the school spelling bee, and Sister has a chance to win! Will she make it to the All-Schools Spelling Bee in Big Bear City, or will she c-r-a-c-k under Papa's pressure? The Berenstain Bears Go on a Ghost Walk: Papa Bear is thrilled to be in charge of the Bear Country School's Halloween ghost walk, promising to make it the spookiest one yet! Will he get carried away with his all his frightening ideas and turn the most haunting night of the year into a Bear's nightmare? The Berenstain Bears Hug and Make Up: After the Bear family wakes up grouchy one morning, they spend the entire day being angry with one another for no reason. How will they learn that hugs are laughter are often the best way to make up? The Berenstain Bears’ Really Big Pet Show: The Bears gets a new pet parakeet just in time for the big pet show at the annual Beartown Festival! Will they go home with a blue ribbon from Mayor Honeypot? The Berenstain Bears and the Trouble with Chores: Papa Bear and the cubs always seem to have a reason to avoid doing their chores. How will the mess in the tree house build up when Mama decides to skip her chores as well? We'd Love To Hear From You! Please share your thoughts in a review! Your experience matters to us. Need tech support? Contact us at support@omapp.com Say hello to us on FB! facebook.com/oceanhousemedia Official HarperCollins licensed app: www.harpercollinschildrens.com

691114189.name: LapTracker - Auto Timer
691114189.description: The automatic lap timer that speaks over 30 languages! LapTracker is a motion detection-based lap timer that can be used to track runners, cyclists, cars, models, swimmers, karts, slot cars etc. The camera view has up to four adjustable detection zones that can be used to track up to four different racers. The iPhone/iPad is placed on the side of the track and laps are automatically counted, timed and spoken. Results are presented in graphical form to enable simple and straightforward comparison of participants, and can also be submitted by email for further analysis. "An excellent tool to help you practice to get the perfect lap" www.TheRCRacer.com

694047660.description: 六个系统：收入支出记账，预算控制，借贷记账，计划与洞悉，外币记账和兑换，存款储蓄记账。 跨平台。 大数据分析（超过15份报表）。所有报表均可进行灵活的设置和过滤。 收入和支出的快速录入系统：目前数据录入只需最少量的点击。 未按时偿还借款时，系统可自动发送短信通知，短信模板可调整。 五位一体：核算收入和支出，核算借贷，计划和预测，外汇核算和兑换，核算存款和储蓄。 通过云端自动同步。 会计报表种类多样，在下拉菜单中灵活配置 计划系统独一无二，不但可以进行计划并自动核算，而且可以在过去一段时间内收入和支出的基础上建立预测。 此外，还有以下一些特点：恢复backup备份，上传csv会计报表，密码保护，个性化配置，不限定收入和支出种类（分组）… 收入和支出子系统可核算和分析资金流动，建立大量财务报表和图表，回答类似下列问题，如“每月在…上平均花费多少？”，“本期收入和支出是多少？”，“现在资金余额是多少？”，“杂项支出是多少？”，“哪些收入和支出是最大的？”“银行卡收入和支出各是多少？”，“现金结算的收入和支出各是多少？”等等。 预算控制支出：用户可随时查看计划、实际情况以及预算执行情况的百分比。用户可为不同的时间区间做收入和支出预算：一天、一周、一月或一年。也可为选定的钱包或所有钱包控制预算。如果超出预算，程序会为用户发出通知。 计划子系统可以输入任意一天的计划收入和支出，在这些数据的基础上可以看到数据中任意一天的资金余额。周期性交易让用户可以快速制定计划，并通知用户定期还款。计划子系统还能在过去一段时间内的基础上自动预测资金余额的变化。资金余额的变化可以在表格和图表中进行分析。在计划数据的基础上可以自动核算收入和支出。 借贷子系统可以进行管理和控制接收和发放的贷款结算。如果输入计划偿还日期，系统会显示偿还贷款的日期控件，显示拖欠贷款及超期时间。根据接收和发放的贷款报表可以立刻给借款人打电话或者发短信。还可以核算从贷款利息得到的钱。 外币核算子系统包括以下功能：使用任意货币核算，自动加载汇率和手动输入汇率，各类货币兑换业务，以表格和图表的形式查看汇率动态，还有在图表中对比各种货币的汇率。 储蓄子目录用于核算存款，用于某种目的递延资产或者只是普通的递延资产。如果存款带有利息的话，从储蓄中收到资金时可以核算利息金额。如果递延资产用作某种目的，那么可以为控制目标实现的进程。

694309958.description: 首次发布优惠*** 获奖应用程序SkyView®的制作方推出了一种不论白天还是晚上，都能发现20,000多颗卫星的全新酷炫方法。 卫星定位现在人人都能用。只需要将你的iPhone指向天空，就能识别国际空间站、哈勃、GPS卫星和上千颗其他卫星，只要它们在你所处位置上空即可。 在“地球”模式中发现有趣的新卫星。转动地球，触碰遥远国家/地区上方的卫星，缩小获取近景视图，然后拍摄奇妙的照片与朋友分享。 特色： 简单：将你的iPhone指向天空，即可识别你所处位置上空经过的卫星。 互动：转动地球，可发现新卫星，缩小可获取漂亮的3D近景视图。 可自定义：建立一个最喜爱的卫星列表，将其他卫星从你的视图中过滤掉。 观测提醒：快速设置提醒，在你的上空中出现肉眼可见的卫星时通知你。 夜晚友好界面：通过两种易于使用的夜间模式（红色和绿色过滤器），维持你的夜间视野。 社交：捕捉美丽图像，并在社交网络上与朋友和家人分享。 太空垃圾：揭开围绕地球旋转的无数火箭残骸及其他空间碎片的面纱。 移动：无需数据信号或GPS即可运行，随时随地均可使用。 综合：包含20,000多颗卫星，提供数以千计的事实数据、描述、 趣闻和卫星图像。

695187101.name: 3D Anatomy
695187101.description: A true and totally 3D app for learning human anatomy with muscle action movies, 3D position quiz and audio pronunciation, built on an advanced interactive 3D touch interface. Want to try the app for free? Click on related apps and download the free version. Features: You can rotate models to any angles and zoom in and out Virtual dissection: Peel layers of muscles and reveal the anatomical structures below them. more than 100 muscle action movies physiology animation videos Major bone markings Muscle descriptions: Origin, Insertion, Nerve, Action 3D location quizzes to test your knowledge Audio pronunciation for all anatomy terms. Latin names Search the name of anatomical structure and reveal the 3D location Switch on/off different anatomy systems Both male and female reproductive systems are available Load and Save Views (bookmaker function) Information from Wikipedia and Gray's anatomy textbook Great for learning anatomy and physiology Support French, Spanish and German languages! Contents: Skeleton (all bones in our body) Ligaments Bone markings Muscles (145 muscles, highly detailed muscle models) Circulation (arteries, vein and heart) Nervous system Respiratory system Reproductive system ( both male and female ) Urinary system 3D Ear 3D Eye Contact Us: Email us at imagemagicstudio@gmail.com. 698042661.name: Gauss Meter
698042661.description: 本程式主要用于磁场的量测及记录，可量测周遭环境或特定对象之磁感应强度，亦可作为金属探测器使用。本程式具有以下特点： 1) 量测值已排除机器本身产生之磁场影响。 2) 量测值即时以动态曲线图呈现。 3) 提供多种单位(nT, µT, mT, mG, G)供使用者选择。 4) 可依使用需求设置量测时间及量测频率。 5) 可设置警戒值，并于磁感应强度达到警戒值时发出警告。 6) 可获得量测点之位置资讯(座标、地址)，并将量测成果显示于地图之上。 7) 所有量测数据均可汇出为csv档，以作为后处理使用。 8) 此外，使用者亦可针对量测数据添加照片、影片、录音或文字描述，以增加量测数据之辨识性。所有照片、影片及录音档均可透过iTunes下载至个人电脑。

698174484.name: Kitchen Scales
698174484.description: Estimate an ingredient when a kitchen scale is not at hand. Bilancia calculates the inner volume of a regularly shaped container and applies its average density to provide an approximate quantity in grams or milliliters. HOW IT WORKS 1. Choose sugar, flour, liquid, or enter a custom density. 2. Select a cylindrical, square, or rectangular container. 3. Match the outer width directly on the iPhone screen, or enter the dimensions manually. 4. Mark the fill level. 5. Read the estimated amount and its uncertainty range. MADE FOR EVERYDAY COOKING Guided, easy-to-follow measurement flow On-screen and manual dimension entry Wall and bottom thickness adjustment Personal screen calibration using a standard bank card Custom ingredient densities Grams-to-ounces converter Shareable results Dark Mode, Dynamic Type, and VoiceOver support PRIVATE BY DESIGN Bilancia works entirely offline. It has no accounts, advertising, analytics, or data collection. Your personal screen calibration stays on your device. IMPORTANT Bilancia does not weigh objects and does not turn the iPhone into a physical scale. Every result is an empirical approximation based on container geometry and average density. Verify important quantities with a real kitchen scale, especially for recipes that require precision.

Made for tiny hands Soft, pressure-sensitive drawing that responds to light touches Musical hexagons that reward curiosity with sound and color No text, buttons, or goals—just open-ended play Full multi-touch so little hands can explore freely A great fit for Guided Access BabyPaints pairs perfectly with Guided Access, keeping your child safely focused on creating. 700043902.name: GuitAfrica
700043902.description: “…I love it! That’s the funkiest stuff ever!“ – John Scofield “GuitAfrica is a wonderful app… it reveals the richness and beauty of Pan-African music in a fun way!“ – Angélique Kidjo Step into the sound world of world-renowned guitarist Lionel Loueke (Benin, West Africa) and discover the vibrant traditions of African music through 22 original songs created exclusively for GuitAfrica. Why You’ll Love It Play with a master – Learn directly from Lionel Loueke’s compositions, performances, and fingerings. Authentic repertoire – Songs inspired by diverse African ethnic groups, rhythms, and instruments. Interactive charts – Standard notation + TAB for guitar and bass, plus full drum and percussion parts. Practice your way – Solo or mute instruments, loop sections, slow down, speed up, and transpose to any key. Learn the feel – Go beyond notes: immerse yourself in rhythm, groove, and phrasing. Studio quality – Professionally recorded with a world-class band and engineer. Every song comes with background notes on the culture and traditions that inspired it, making GuitAfrica both a learning tool and a listening experience. Many users say they find themselves coming back to the music just to enjoy it. Perfect for: Guitarists and bassists who want to expand their vocabulary. Drummers and percussionists looking to deepen their rhythmic understanding. Musicians of all kinds who want to connect with Africa’s rich musical heritage. Features at a Glance: 22 exclusive songs by Lionel Loueke Full scores + parts for guitar, bass, drums, percussion Standard notation + TAB with exact fingerings Loop, slow down, transpose, mute/solo controls Cultural context & history for each song GuitAfrica sits at the crossroads of art and learning—an app that teaches, inspires, and plays like a record.

700513526.description: Thanks for more than 100,000 downloads! Now for Apple Watch® and is evolving. Now with handoff support. Listen to your music in the way that you've always wanted. NOTICE: This app is designed for music synced or purchased with iTunes. Apple Music tracks for offline playback are not supported for equalizing. Customize your experience with a 10 bands equalizer and use different presents or build your own settings library assignable to songs, albums, lists and even genres!. Every time you hear you music will be your own particular experience! FEATURES: Handoff - Start your music on your iPhone®/iPad® and continue on another device by bringing the album detail (playlists not supported yet). The app for Apple Watch® also handoff the Album Detail (list of songs). Search - Just pull down the user interface in the cover flow screen (like iOS 7+). Supports dynamic type. Settings - Just pull up the user interface in the cover flow screen. Sorting & Filtering - Tap on the top of the cover flow screen. Songs/Albums Queue (or play next dynamic list) Drag&drop playlist editor. Video player (for videos stored on your device). iPad Multitasking 3D Touch® 10 Bands Equalizer Equalizer Presets library Equalizer Widget Recent Albums Widget Free Stickers for iMessage® Network detection for media in the cloud. 700740791.name: Squeezy
700740791.description: Squeezy has helped thousands of women regain confidence in their pelvic floor. Pelvic health specialists around the world recommend Squeezy to their patients every day because it works! If you are thinking about downloading Squeezy for your pelvic floor, you are not alone. All women should be doing these exercises and some will be doing them as part of a physiotherapy programme. Squeezy is simple to use, informative and designed to help women to remember to do their pelvic floor muscle exercises (also known as Kegel exercises). Features includes: A pre-set exercise plan that follows public health guidelines A record of the number of exercises you have completed, compared to your target Visual and audio prompts for exercises Exercise reminders with customisable settings Educational information about the pelvic floor “Professional mode” – if working with a pelvic health specialist, you can tailor the exercise plan to fit your needs A bladder diary to keep track of your symptoms, if required Simple and clear interface Squeezy was designed by chartered physiotherapists specialising in pelvic health working in the NHS. It has been clinically reviewed and approved by the NHS for its clinical safety, and is compliant with NHS Information Governance requirements. Squeezy won several industry awards including ehi Awards 2016, Health Innovation Network 2016, National Continence Care Awards 2015/16 and was a finalist for awards including Advancing Healthcare Awards 2014 and 2017, Abbvie Sustainable Healthcare Awards 2016. The app is UKCA marked as Class I medical device in the United Kingdom and developed in compliance with Medical Devices Regulations 2002 (SI 2002 No 618, as amended). For more about Squeezy and additional pelvic health information visit squeezyapp.com.

701084505.name: My Little Pony Party of One
701084505.trackName: My Little Pony Party of One
701084505.description: Thank You for ONE MILLION Downloads!! Get ready for an adventure with Pinkie Pie and her friends in MY LITTLE PONY, Party of One, an intriguing new interactive tale about the magic of friendship. Who throws better parties than Pinkie Pie? Having just finished one celebration, Pinkie Pie sets off to invite all of her favorite ponies to a NEW party, but suddenly every pony seems to be QUITE busy. What’s going on? Join the investigation as Pinkie Pie visits her My Little Pony friends looking for clues. Bold graphics, bright colors and lots of animations make Party of One an enjoyable and engaging way to be entertained and practice reading skills. Perfect for My Little Pony fans and beginning readers. Key Features: Your favorite ponies are here: Pinkie Pie, Rainbow Dash, Fluttershy, Applejack, Twilight Sparkle and more! Featuring the official voice of PINKIE PIE from the show FRIENDSHIP IS MAGIC Watch the characters animate in playful moments during every story spread 17 scenes that come to life as children tap and explore each page. Tap on the ponies to move the adventure forward Highlighted words to help test and build age-appropriate vocabulary Word round-up to reinforce learning goals Parents can track children’s learning progress Learning Goals: Everyone wants to belong. MY LITTLE PONY Party of One uses thoughtful language and lively scenes to gently help children to understand their feelings about friendship membership, tensions and misunderstandings. Practice reading skills Introduces new vocabulary words Test problem solving skills Social Emotional skills Social skills may be reinforced by parents and children reading together and discussing: Seeing things from someone else’s perspective Understanding the dilemma that both the ponies and Pinkie Pie are facing Developing empathy for both Pinkie Pie and her friends. Learning how to maintain supportive and honest friendships Understanding the importance of communication and learning View the trailer http://youtu.be/QlBCgIul_9U

701650924.name: Camera Angle
701650924.description: While shooting a picture, You can confirm the direction and the angle of the device at a glance. This app is available in various scenes. For example, when you want to take exactly the building by horizontal and vertical, the documents from just above, the ceiling paintings, with adjust the direction, and so on. [PAN] Angle of the left and right as the vertical axis of the device. Direction of the compass is displayed when the screen is perpendicular to the ground. [TILT] Angle of the up and down as the horizontal axis of the device. [ROLL] Angle of the rotation as the front and back axis of the device. Direction of the compass is displayed when the screen is horizontal to the ground. Compatible with front/rear camera, flash AUTO/ON/OFF, auto focus/tap focus.

702519995.name: Precision Boxing Coach Pro
702519995.description: It’s finally here for iOS, an app that simulates a boxing coach and calls out realistic, fast paced combinations. The boxing coach simulator calls out boxing techniques for you to execute, there are 4 modes and 3 intensity levels. This includes a Southpaw Mode, Counter Punching Mode, Virtual Padwork and Combo Creator Mode. Choose as many rounds as you like, adjust the round length, the rest between rounds, and set a warning bell to tell you how many seconds are left in the round. Press ‘Start’ and get to work!

704083918.name: 无损图片瘦身 - 优化，压缩JPG等相片尺寸大小
704083918.trackName: 无损图片瘦身 - 优化，压缩JPG等相片尺寸大小
704083918.description: 限时1折促销。原价100元。只为手快的您准备。 不要错过“超级抠图”，一键抠图工具，从此告别PS的蜗牛抠图。现正半价促销。需要的快下手！ 无损图片瘦身Lossless Photo Squeezer是一款大量压缩图像容量而丝毫无损图片质量的专业工具。专业优化PNG，JPEG和GIF等格式的图片大小。您可以优化您所有的照片，从而挤出大量的硬盘空间，网络空间，同时，您可以更多更快地在线储存和共享照片。 更特别的是，无损图片瘦身Lossless Photo Squeezer支持导入整个目录（包括子目录），而图片输出时可以回到原有目录结构。正是这种独特的功能，你不需要花费额外的时间来重新组织那些被您优化后照片。 它是如何工作的？ 有三种模式供您选择：质量完全无损模式（PNG，JPG，GIF）;质量轻微受损模式（JPG）；PNG 8位模式。 质量完全无损模式（PNG，JPG，GIF），将节省空间 > 20 ％ ，但保持原有的分辨率，质量完全无损。 质量轻微受损模式（JPG），将节省空间 > 50 ％，质量轻微损失。 PNG 8位模式，将PNG 24色转换为PNG 256色，节省空间 > 60％ 优点： 节约宝贵的网络空间，网上帐户空间，硬盘空间等等。 大大节约网络传输时间。上传50张高清图像到您的在线图库通常需要1小时，而使用无损图片瘦身Lossless Photo Squeezer后，您就只需要花费10分钟而已。 节省人力。这个有用的工具可以让您迅速在网上发图，而不是打开Photoshop或其他应用工具先编辑后才能发。 无视邮箱容量的限制.在大多数情况下，你只能用邮箱发送10 MB大小的附件。而无损图片瘦身Lossless Photo Squeezer可以帮您的图片轻松瘦身。 特点： 简单易用。 三种模式供您选择：质量完全无损模式（PNG，JPG，GIF）；质量轻微受损模式（JPG）；PNG 8位模式。 支持导入整个目录（包括子目录），而图片输出时可以回到原有目录结构。 直接拖动照片，文件夹到程序中优化。 缩小图片的同时，图片质量无损。 支持单图或批处理。 反馈： 任何建议将不胜感激，支持邮箱：market@effectmatrix.com

704307168.name: 活字帖+
704307168.description: 你是否曾想像自己如书法大师一样挥毫呢？来试试吧，用你的手指在iPad和iPhone上练习毛笔书法。 “活字帖”利用中国古代名家书法作品中的原笔迹，在你描摹或者临帖时绘制出来，使得你的书法效果能媲美真迹，让你体验如书法家一样的练字感受，更真切的感受书法的魅力。 本作与现有大多数作品的最大区别在于，大多数现有的作品只是根据手指运行轨迹，用计算机计算模拟出类似于毛笔笔迹的效果。但是，因为触摸屏的限制，计算机再如何聪明，又如何能知道用户运笔时的轻重缓急，浓淡干湿呢？故本作规避了用笔技巧，着重于练习每个字的字体结构。因此，本作并不能代替笔墨纸砚的常规练字方法，但是却可以从一定程度上提高用户的书法水平。 本应用的特点： 1. 高保真：在iPhone到iPad的尺度上，尽量保留原帖字迹； 2. 动态欣赏：能欣赏字贴的动态效果，并与之交互； 3. 练习结构：使用独特的方法练习原帖字迹，掌握字体结构。 本App现有8个字帖: 兰亭集序（王羲之） 基本笔画（楷书四大家） 快雪时晴帖（王羲之） 南无阿弥陀佛（弘一法师） 秾芳诗帖（宋徽宗） 仲尼梦奠帖（欧阳询） 琴赋（文徵明） 般若波罗蜜多心经 (赵孟頫) 希望大家喜欢。

709617332.name: Daxiang Dictionary
709617332.description: โปรแกรมพจนานุกรม 大象词典 โปรแกรมยอดนิยมสำหรับ iPhone และ iPad รวบรวมคำศัพท์ด้านภาษามากกว่า 200,000 รายการ 大象词典是 iPhone 和 iPad 最受欢迎的软件，收集的词汇超过 200,000条 คุณสมบัติ 1.	ไม่ต้องต่ออินเตอร์เน็ต ในการค้นหาคำศัพท์ 2. รวบรวมคำศัพท์สำคัญที่จำเป็นในการเรียนการสอนมากกว่า 200,000 รายการ ครอบคลุมคำศัพท์ HSK 1-6 3.	ค้นหาได้ทั้ง ภาษาไทย ภาษาจีนตัวย่อ ภาษาจีนตัวเต็ม และพินอิน 4.	แสดงชนิดของคำศัพท์พร้อมประโยคตัวอย่าง 5.	แชร์หน้าคำศัพท์ ส่งให้เพื่อนผ่านแอพพลิเคชั่นต่าง ๆ ได้ หรือจะเก็บไว้ใช้เป็น flashcard ในการท่องคำศัพท์ ก็ได้ 6.	Copy คำศัพท์เพื่อนำไปใช้ประโยชน์อื่น ๆ 7.	แสดงหน้าค้นหาล่าสุด เพื่อดูประวัติการค้นหาที่ผ่านมา 8.	ออนไลน์ สื่อการเรียนรู้ เพื่อประโยชน์ในการเรียนรู้ภาษาจีน เช่น นิทาน ไทย จีน มิวสิควีดีโอเพลงจีนพร้อมคำแปล หมวดหมู่คำศัพท์ การใช้คำศัพท์ประเภทต่าง ๆ เป็นต้น 9.	เปลี่ยนอักษรจีนตัวย่อหรือตัวเต็มได้ง่ายดาย เพียงกดปุ่มเดียวตลอดเวลาในการใช้งาน 10.	เก็บคำศัพท์ที่ชื่นชอบไว้ดูย้อนหลังได้ 11.	ปรับขนาดตัวอักษรได้หลายขนาด เพื่อสะดวกในการใช้งาน 12.	ออกเสียง จีนกลาง จีนกวางตุ้ง 13.	คำศัพท์ทั้งหมด แปลจากเจ้าของภาษาโดยตรง ทำให้ได้คำแปลที่ตรงกับความหมายที่แท้จริงของแต่ละภาษา โดยไม่ได้ใช้ข้อมูลจากอินเตอร์เน็ต หรือโปรแกรมสำเร็จรูป 14.	ใช้ได้ทั้งแนวตั้งและแนวนอน 15. แสดงหมวดหมู่คำศัพท์ 软件的其他性能 1.	在搜索单词的过程中无需连接网络。 2.	收集多达200,000个在教学上有必用到的生词。 3.	可以通过打入泰文、拼音、简体字和繁体字还进行搜索。 4.	显示出各种词语的分类和句子。 5.	可以把单词通过各种软件来分享给朋友，或者收集为单词卡片以方便浏览。 6.	可以复制单词以用到其他事情上。 7.	显示出最近搜索单词和保存所有搜索记录。 8.	在线学习平台，为了学习汉语而用，比如泰语故事和汉语故事、具有泰语翻译的汉语歌曲视频、各种泰国-中国新闻、等等。 9.	可以通过轻轻一按就互换简体-繁体。 10.	收集喜欢的单词以稍后观看。 11.	随着使用者的需求来调整文字的大小。 12.	普通话和广东话的发音。 13.	所有单词是通过语言主人的直接翻译，导致得到与每种语言相同意思的翻译解释，并没有使用网络或其他软件的资料。 14.	屏幕可以随意横竖旋转。 15. 分类词汇 คุณสมบัติพิเศษเฉพาะ มีความสามารถในการเชื่อมโยงคำศัพท์ แบบไม่จำกัด เมื่อเราค้นหาคำศัพท์ แอพจะแสดงความหมายของคำนั้นออกมา จากนั้นเราสามารถกดที่ความหมายนั้น ๆ เพื่อให้แอพค้นหาการเชื่อมโยงคำศัพท์อื่น ๆ ที่มีความหมายเดียวกันนั้นออกมาได้ เราสามารถกดคำเชื่อมโยงลักษณะนี้ไปเรื่อย ๆ แบบไม่จำกัด และสามารถกดย้อนกลับไปกลับมาได้ โดยแอพจะแสดงปุ่มพร้อมตัวอักษร ไว้ที่ด้านบนของแถบความหมาย 特殊特色 此软件可以无限的接连单词，当使用者搜索单词时，此软件将显示出所单词的意思，然后使用者可以点击该单词意思以让软件继续为你搜索其他有相同和相似解释的更多单词。我们可以继续这样无限地点击，以及可以点返回和前进，而软件将在解释栏的上面显示出按钮包括文字。

711042441.name: Chordana Viewer
711042441.description: [Compatible devices] iPhone6 or later(Except for the iPhone SE), iPad Pro, iPad(5th generation or later), iPad Air or later, iPad mini(4th generation or later) [System requirements] iOS 11.0 or later required. ＊Important＊ ・To use iTunes in the Cloud songs (songs purchased or played through the iTunes Match service), first download the songs to a terminal. ・The names of iTunes in the Cloud songs that have not been downloaded to a terminal are shown on the song list, regardless of terminal settings. ・Songs protected by DRM cannot be used even if downloaded. ＝Support for writing the chord chart for your favorite songs＝ ○ Product Features ○ An application that analyzes the tones played in an audio file and helps you write the chord chart. Audio files in your iPad or iPhone are analyzed by the original Casio Chordana technology, and the sounds played in each song are displayed on the screen as chord chart. At the same time, the chord positions for the instrument are displayed as the song plays. You can also play the results of the chord analysis on the instrument pad to check the outcomes. You can then edit the chords yourself as you listen to the actual sounds and write even more accurate chord chart. This is so much quicker and easier than trying to figure out the chords just by listening to them. As well as being able to save analyzed or edited chords, you can also exchange them via email with other Chordana Viewer users or print them out on an AirPrint-compatible printer. The analyzed chords will be a close match to the mood of the song, but may not necessarily be the same chords as those used in the original. ＜Displaying chords matched to the song[Chord display pane]＞ As well as showing the analyzed chords, the app has a guide bar that moves along with song playback, allowing you to check the chords being played in real time. The app also supports full-screen display so that you can just check the chord chart. 『Chord Guide』 By touching a chord in the chord display pane, you can check the chord position for the instrument selected in the Performance pane. 『Editing Chords』 You can modify the chord chart by choosing a chord from up to three candidate chords that are closest in sound to the analyzed chord. You can also specify the chord manually. You can also adjust barline position. ＜Tapping a performance by watching the chord positions[Performance pane]＞ Navigate in the screen using the piano or guitar finger positions to match the chord display. Of course, you can also use the chord list to check the position display for chords that are not shown. To play the chords, select the piano pad or guitar pad. To play individual notes, select them on piano keyboard. You can also use the recording function to record your performances. You can also purchase additional instruments and types of tones as add-ons. ＜Customize your own tempo, key and vocal balance＞ By using the app to import an audio file into your iPad or iPhone, you can modify the tempo or key of the song. You can also adjust the balance between vocals and accompaniment, which is useful for transcription. If you change the key, the chords in the chord display pane are also converted automatically, so transposition is simple. ＜The Technology Behind Chordana＞ The Chordana series apps use original Casio technology to analyze audio files. The apps achieve unprecedented success in extracting natural chords from the time changes and the distribution of frequency components included in audio waveforms, while also taking into account the characteristics of the harmonies, melodies and rhythm instruments included in the song.

711410531.name: Polyglot - English Listening
711410531.description: This application is designed to teach English speech reception. Texts contain words and expressions that are hard to understand to those, who study American English. Regardless meanings of these words and expression, you will learn their history of origin. All texts were sounded by professional speakers. Simultaneously with speech of speaker an English text and translation will be displayed simultaneously. Mastered material will be tested. Application has one type of tests: Test of English speech perception – you should check sentences spoken by speaker in English text. Order of training may be individually chosen. Simultaneous training is allowed for not more than three texts. In order to open new texts, you should pass the test. Retest may only advance your result. If you passed the text worst then you passed the last time, your score will not change. Application features: Test of English speech reception Test of English speech understanding Flexible adjustment of training schedule All texts were sounded by professional speakers. Simultaneous highlight of English text and translation Application uses materials from the VOA website http://learningenglish.voanews.com/

713258885.name: ColorMeter RGB Colorimeter
713258885.description: 有了ColorMeter，你可以通过使用你的iPhone、iPad或iPod touch的摄像头，轻松而快速地确定颜色值。此外，你还可以从你设备的相册中选择一张图片。 使用你的设备的内置摄像头来测量环境中的颜色值! 713576895.name: Jotalicious
713576895.description: Jotalicious is a beautifully-designed shopping assistant that turns plain text lists into color-coded checklists of awesome. It works the way a shopping assistant on your phone should – you create lists just like you are jotting a note to yourself and Jotalicious organizes your lists into sortable, taggable checklists. When Jotalicious finds the name of a place next to an item in your list – for example, "Fresh Herbs @Farmers Market" – it automatically tags and adds the item to a virtual shopping list for that place too. If typing is just too old school for you, use your device's voice dictation* feature to speak your lists into Jotalicious – say the phrase, "New Line" to separate each item on your list and Jotalicious does the rest. It's good to share, and with Jotalicious it's even better. Jotalicious is on the spot with AirDrop, AirPrint, text message, and email sharing support. You can send text copies of your lists to anyone or you can share a "jot", which can be imported, complete with tags, by other Jotalicious users. And all of those text lists people send you – or lists you find on your favorite blog or elsewhere – can be pasted into Jotalicious to create new lists effortlessly – just copy text and paste awesome! Jotalicious is shopping list bliss – after you dictate, paste, or jot your first list, you'll wonder how you ever lived without it. (*NOTE: Voice Dictation is not available on all devices. If your device supports voice dictation, you will see a microphone icon next to the spacebar when your device displays a keyboard.)

713925239.name: MultiChrono
713925239.description: MultiChrono is a stopwatch that lets you record multiple times of different participants in any sporting event. With independent controls and indicators, you can follow each of the individual participants. Also, it features lap control and graphic delta insight, including a large number of export formats, such as PDF,CSV,XLS,TXT... as well as background and dark mode support.

715668236.name: MyTeeth
715668236.description: „MyTeeth“ helps Kids ages 1 to 9 to brush their teeth gladly and well. Patiently for 3 minutes, with joy, with the right technique for their age und without missing a spot, that’s how our toothbrush buddies brush and your your kid is learning by imitating. Additionally „MyTeeth“ motivates your child every day and includes all the information for parents to support their child optimally. ________________ Why „MyTeeth“ Correct tooth brushing in childhood lays the foundation for lifelong, healthy dental hygiene! Because Teeth can only be patched and not healed. "MyTeeth" is a beautifully animated app for children ages 1 - 9 (but for teens and adults, too) that helps to establish the best possible tooth brushing routine. Accompanied by one of the cute toothbrush buddies, who knows all the techniques and never forgets a spot, your child only has to imitate what is shown. Imitation is what children do best and how they learn best. The recommended three minutes fly by and "MyTeeth" can even play your child's favourite music. (Some adults use the app for a relaxing brushing time). Your child will be motivated to brush regularly with small stickers and new toothbrushes. Additionally, each character has his own little story, of course about the toothbrushing topic. „MyTeeth“ can be easily adapted to your child's current abilities, from circular brushing to the bass method, and contains lots of useful tips and information in the parent area, from oral hygiene during pregnancy to dental floss and the choice of the right toothbrush - all-round care. Co-developed and recommended by dentists, loved by children. Change your child's tooth future today. _____________________________________ “MyTeeth“ makes all the difference 6 lovingly animated toothbrush friends: With their own personality and individual quotations With its own background story With personal trait With own stickers Left- and right-handed 4 cleaning techniques: simple brushing, circular cleaning, red-to-white and the bass method 2 sequences: Pedagogical and Classical (KAI) Motivation for your children: New stickers for daily cleaning New toothbrushes every 6 weeks Generic and individual slogans to engage Illustrations by Christian Heuser Includes iMessage app Individual settings for each toothbrush buddy possible „MyTeeth“ Music included Or choose your own music Step-by-step instructions for parents in our How & Why reference book: Current medical knowledge Learn everything you need about kids teeth How kids gradually learn to brush their teeth Explanation of the different brushing techniques And many useful tips and details Webseite: TheKeptPromise.com Facebook: facebook.com/TheKeptPromise Twitter: @TheKeptPromise

717786312.description: Fliptastic Pro — 无水印、解锁额外转场，随时创作。 Fliptastic Pro是排名第一的照片幻灯片制作应用的高级版本。将照片变成TikTok、Instagram Reels、YouTube等平台的精美专业视频。 PRO专属特权 ・所有视频永不带水印 ・解锁额外电影级转场效果 — 交叉淡化、翻转、肯伯恩斯、缩放、模糊、弹跳等 AI智能创建 智能AI自动挑选您最好的照片，并将它们编排成完美的幻灯片。它会分析画质、人脸、构图和光线——让每个视频都令人惊艳。 适配所有平台 以完美格式导出到任意社交平台： ・9:16 适用于TikTok和Instagram Reels ・16:9 适用于YouTube ・1:1 方形帖子 ・8:10 适用于Instagram 内置音乐库 从26首精选主题曲中选择，完美搭配您的幻灯片。您的视频将看起来和听起来一样精彩。 照片编辑器和滤镜 使用13种精美滤镜、裁剪、旋转以及亮度、对比度和饱和度调节来精修每张照片——全部在应用内完成。 精美文字幻灯片 使用精选装饰字体（如Billabong、Pacifico和Permanent Marker）添加标题和字幕。非常适合片头、片尾和故事叙述。 主题特效包 使用可选特效让您的视频更上一层楼： ・爱情包 — 爱心、浪漫边框和音乐 ・星光包 — 闪闪发光的星星效果 ・银河包 — 高级电影级转场 ・月光包 — 适合庆祝活动的节日特效 可选高级订阅 一次订阅解锁全部——40多种转场、25首以上主题曲、所有特效包，以及未来所有内容。 内置图库照片 在应用内直接浏览来自Pexels的数千张精美图库图片。 更多精彩功能 ・无限项目保存，随时编辑 ・拖放排列照片 ・逐张幻灯片时长控制 ・多种图片适配模式（适配、填充、模糊填充） ・实时活动和灵动岛进度追踪 ・撤销/重做支持 ・直接分享到Instagram、Facebook和YouTube Fliptastic Pro — 无限制创作。 Subscription Terms: Fliptastic Premium is available as a monthly or yearly auto-renewable subscription Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase Subscription automatically renews unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period You can manage and cancel subscriptions in your Apple ID account settings Privacy Policy: https://fliptastic.amdcopper.workers.dev/privacy-policy Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

717812802.name: 韩语发音 - 韩语入门与四十音图
717812802.trackName: 韩语发音 - 韩语入门与四十音图
717812802.description: 零基础韩语入门 App —— 四十音、口语、听力、跟读、AI 解析,一个 App 全搞定。 【核心模块】 一、发音:韩语 40 字母 + 每日精选 四十音点读卡,元音、辅音双视图,哪里不会点哪里。原汁原味的标准发音,配合笔画动画与口型示例,告别"哑巴韩语"。 每日精选,每日更新一句高频场景句。 单词与拼写,从字母拼读开始,渐进式词汇与拼写练习,配合可点击例句。 二、口语:700+ 高频短句,覆盖 7 大场景 按真实使用频率筛选,覆盖日常礼貌、交通、住宿、就餐、购物、旅游、其他 7 大场景。 口语列表分类清晰,支持搜索与收藏。一键收藏易忘句子,随时回看。练习模块内置录音器对比发音,纠正薄弱环节。热力图可视化每日练习频次,养成长效习惯。 三、听力:句子拆解 + 话题训练 听句训练将长句拆分为短句,逐句播放、跟读、听写。听力话题精选多场景听力素材,配套 AI 解析。 AI 智能解析,上传一段韩语,AI 自动拆分语法成分、词性、用法与中文释义,让每一句韩语都能被真正看懂。 【适用人群】 赴韩留学 / 旅游 / 工作的零基础学习者;看韩剧、听 K-Pop 想听懂更多台词的粉丝;因工作需要掌握基础韩语口语的职场人士;中高级韩语学习者查漏补缺。

717812812.name: 日语发音 - JLPT与日语五十音图
717812812.trackName: 日语发音 - JLPT与日语五十音图
717812812.description: 一个帮助日语初学者系统学习日语五十音、基础口语与日常对话的实用工具。 随身携带的日语老师，从五十音入门到流利对话，一步到位。 涵盖日常生活中的高频场景——商店、旅行、酒店、餐馆等，操作简便、界面直观、内容丰富。 应用功能 （1）日语五十音 完整的五十音图学习，包含清音、浊音、拗音三大板块。每个假名均配有标准发音、例词演示与手写训练，帮助初学者扎实掌握日语字母的基础。 （2）基础口语与短句 精选日常高频口语短句，按礼仪、交通、住宿、饮食、购物、旅行等七大场景分类。每句均支持音频播放、跟读录音与收藏，配合口语练习热力图，让学习过程一目了然。 （3）AI 情景对话 内置多种真实对话场景（如餐厅点餐、酒店入住、问路等），与 AI 进行沉浸式日语对话练习。支持多轮交互，即时反馈，打造接近母语环境的口语训练体验。 （4）每日一句 每日推送一句精选日语短句，附带 AI 智能解析，从语法、词汇、文化背景多维度拆解。支持慢速与常速播放，适合碎片化学习。 （5）听句与单词卡 逐词拆分播放句子，强化听力理解；每日单词卡片帮助积累核心词汇。 （6）日语数字转换 输入阿拉伯数字即可实时转换为日语汉字、平假名与罗马音，支持 TTS 朗读。内置 0-10 万常用数字快捷入口，方便快速查阅。 （7）日本文化与色彩 内置日本城市地图浏览和日本传统色彩图鉴，在学习语言的同时感受日本文化之美。 （8）口语练习录音 支持句子跟读录音与回放，随时对比自己的发音与标准发音，持续改进口语表达。 （9）听力训练 丰富的听力素材覆盖日常对话、场景对话等，支持原文与译文对照学习，逐步提升日语语感与听力理解能力。

720810459.name: Xynthesizr
720810459.description: Xynthesizr is a streamlined yet capable 32-step matrix sequencer/monotimbral synthesizer with generative features and MIDI. "This really is a lot of fun and, hooked up to a synth like Thor or Z3TA+, there are plenty of creative options to be explored here." - John Walden, musicappblog.com "Xynthesizr is about the only tone matrix app that can keep up with my short attention span. There are so many ways to shape, and constantly reshape, your sound... There's a lot to play with here!" - Tim Webb, discchord.com "Overall, Xynthesizr is a very interesting instrument that is fun to play and lovely to look at." - Tom Flint, Sound on Sound "Xynthesizr holds a lot of creative potential, and between a user friendly interface, a practical onboard synth, inspiring generative features, and solid MIDI implementation, this is a useful tool that can really benefit a wide range of iOS musicians." - Chip Boaz, iosmusicandyou.com "...one of my absolute go-to apps" - Sean Garland, iosmars.com Create patterns and modify them in real time, or let Xynthesizr do it for you using its morphing algorithms. Change scale and key, or transpose within a scale on-the-fly. Tweak parameters of the internal synthesizer or output MIDI to your favorite apps and devices. Record and share your creations. 721321563.description: 轻松快速地从现有视频中删除音频，同时保持视频的解析度和品质无损。 在常去的社交网站上分享时非常实用: 不让朋友们听到你在视频中说的每一句话。 消除不喜欢的背景噪音，仅专注于影像。 输入视频可以通过多种方式从设备导入。 视频的修改版本（如果有）或原始版本均可用。 如果需要，可以将相机直接用于录制视频。 您也可以将设备连接到计算机，以拖放特定的视频（“文件”功能）。 输出视频可以通过几种方式导出。 在“照片”应用或“文件”应用中创建新视频。 通过添加编辑版本直接修改输入视频。 将视频共享到另一个应用程序。 此应用程序可以运行，在你的iPhone和iPad上，作为一个独立的应用程序，作为照片扩展名，或作为行动扩展（从像照片应用程序的兼容的应用程序）。 支持横向和纵向显示。 支持iOS13的暗模式。 您将看到原始直观的用户界面，与我们所有的视频应用程序相同。 这些应用程序已多次被苹果和其他各网站收录。

721606556.name: 有数 - 重新定义计算器
721606556.trackName: 有数 - 重新定义计算器
721606556.description: 有数是一款新型计算器，开创性地克服传统计算器的局限性，打造真正现代化的计算体验。 特色功能：响应式结果、可编辑历史记录、关联数字、文字注释、自由画布、拖动数字、共享、实时图表等等。 特色功能： 响应式结果：编辑画布上的任何数字，可以立即看到所有计算结果的更新。让计算器为您工作，而不是反其道行之。 关联数字：选中计算结果后，按下任何计算功能，都会在计算结果下方创建一个有关联的新数字，继续计算下去。改变关联数字中的任何一个，所有关联数字都会跟着更新。 所有历史记录都存储在一张无限滚动的画布上。您可以随心所欲地拖动数字并重新使用这些数字。 用附带的文字标签对任何数字进行注释，就像自由式电子表格一样。 使用数字上的滑块可以调整数值，并实时查看计算结果和图表更新。点按滑块可以在离散模式和连续模式间切换。 支持撤销操作。 三种方法共享计算结果：将计算结果复制为文字；将图表复制为图片；或者使用共享菜单，共享所有可见计算结果的剪裁图片。 实时图表：长按任何您想设定为“x”的数字，并点按“图表”操作。这可将该数字关联为“x”，并将表达式的结果关联为“y"。表达式中的任何变化都会引起图表的实时更新。 支持外接蓝牙键盘，以便快速输入数字和基本运算（+, -, *, /）。 有数无需连网即可正常使用。 计算有若光速，强劲的计算引擎可支持20个以上数学计算功能。

722198813.name: Damki Town Kids Coloring Book
722198813.description: Yippie, the world can be painted! The Damki Town coloring book with funny animal illustrations by Danadamki is waiting to be colored by creative children. For kids from 4. The group of crazy animal residents who live in Damki Town can be colored by kids with a large, bright colour palette. Furthermore the kids can add funny accessoires to the colored animals. But who are the funny animal residents the kids can color? There are Simone, the hungry squirrel, Richie, the chubby circus bear and Larry, the flying lama. But all three have many more animal friends, who are waiting to have more color in their lives. Damki Town can be enjoyed by anyone who enjoys coloring. For kids from 4 to 99 years old, or even older! Kids can save their finished artworks, send the colored pics to their friends, or share them on Facebook so that everyone can see how colorful the coloring book Damki Town is. Proudly presented by Ahoiii with illustrations by Danadamki. 725195676.name: Quicka2 - 検索を快適に
725195676.description: Quicka2 は、素早く快適に検索を行うためのアプリです。 起動するとキーボードが自動で立ち上がり、どのアプリよりもスムーズに快適に検索を行うことができます。 このアプリを一度使って検索すると、この快適さが当たり前になります。 主な特徴 サジェスト機能 ライブラリから URL スキームを追加して、Web 検索の強化と、他アプリとの連携を強化 検索クエリ履歴 画面端を左右スワイプで検索／ブラウザ画面を移動 検索バーに文字を入力せずにキーボードの検索を押すとクリップボードの文字列で検索 検索エンジンをカスタマイズ オリジナルアイコン作成機能 エンコーディング UTF-8・Shift-JIS・EUC に対応。アクション URL に登録された [U], [S], [E] は（それぞれの頭文字）、エンコードされた検索バーの文字列に置き換えられます 他アプリから Quicka を起動。quicka2://?text=X で X を検索バーに格納して立ち上がります ダークモード対応 以下のウェブサイトで詳しい情報を掲載しています。 http://rakuishi.com ※ 前作 Quicka では、iPhone／iPad 対応していましたが、Quicka2 では iPad への対応予定は今のところありません。

725234217.name: Rock Drum Machine
725234217.description: Turn your iPhone or iPad into a solid Rock Drummer with powerful drum sounds and tons of rhythms to get rock drum drums grooves easily in a flash. The AI drum machine for Rock! RDM jams! Just move a slider to set the jamming level like a proper drummer! 2d Slider to control jam level ( x - horizontal ) and intensity ( y - vertical ) The Live Pads allows to play live sessions on the way with 8 assignable pads and buttons for fills, intro, end with midi controls. Now with assignable Midi Map, for controls and MIDI out notes. Synchronize any app easily with Ableton Link. Export Full or Multitrack Audio and Midi File, available from iOS 12. Song Mode. An easy and fast way to make quality drums for your songs. Double press to edit a part or song Long press to move parts or songs Save all your data to iCloud to have several song lists, rhythms or repertorios and share them among your devices Edit or create your own rhythms very easily in two modes: Edit Mode allows you to edit the whole rhythm quickly. Patterns Mode allows you to set the patterns for each component (hihat/ride cymbal, snare or kick )easily with a wheel. Combine the best acoustic drum sounds with any rhythm to get top inspiring rock grooves. Midi Sync + Inter App Audio + Audiobus. Stream live audio directly to other Audiobus or Inter App Audio apps! 4 Effects : Compressor / Gate, Equalizer , Delay, Reverb Set random fills every 4, 8, 12 , 16, 32 bars In Groove Edit Mode you can set any subdivision to any beats. Just long press on the time until it shows a red border and drag up or down to rest or add notes Midi Outt MIDI CONTROLS --- Assignable Midi Controls. 725274537.name: Symmetrain
725274537.description: Winner of the IGF 2014 Student Showcase * Symmetrain, high score chase in symmetry! Choose your train and spot all differences as quickly as you can while driving from train station to train station. But be aware, every mistake delays your train until it disappears out of view. Don't let this happen! Use the emergency brake in tricky passages and bring all passengers safely to the next train station. Challenge your friends and show them who has the best reaction and highest high score while mastering faster trains in different landscapes! ++ Pocketgamer.co.uk quote ++ “It's an ingenious concept, and it works well in practice. The controls are simple and responsive, and the whole thing is lifted by some excellent, picturebook-style hand-drawn artwork.” Eight trains to unlock and play. each with a different speed, look and travel route. Dynamic generated game play – every challenge is a new challenge! A game for everyone – easy trains for beginners and children, faster and more difficult trains as you improve. A picturesque world full of lovely hand-drawn graphics A smooth guitar soundtrack that you will not forget Game Center integration and iCloud synchronization - compete against your friends for the ultimate highscore!

725336480.name: Videocraft: Video Maker
725336480.description: Videocraft is a complete multi-track video editor, photo slideshow maker, and movie maker app. Combine video clips and photos with music, sound effects, voice-over, images, GIFs, and text in one powerful timeline. With a beautiful and simple design, anyone can create and share amazing videos in minutes. All features are available with no subscription and no watermarks. Feature Highlights Files Integration Use videos, photos, images, GIFs, and music stored in iCloud Files. Project Aspect Ratio, Resolution, and Frame Rate Create square (1:1), standard (4:3), wide (16:9), or extra-wide (2:1) projects. Choose landscape or portrait orientation. Export in 4K, 1080p, or 720p. Choose 30fps or 60fps. Add Multiple Video Clips and Photos Add videos and photos from Photos or Files. Trim video clips to use only the segment you need. Crop, pan, and zoom video clips and photos to fill or fit your project aspect ratio. Mute video clip audio or adjust its volume. Add fade in, fade out, and crossfade transitions. Set the duration of each photo. Change the video background color. Ken Burns Effect Create beautiful photo stories with smooth pan and zoom motion. Reverse Video Slow / Fast Motion Stop Motion Convert long videos into stop motion videos. Import multiple photos and play them in sequence to create stop motion movies. Video Over Video (PIP, B-Roll) Add multiple videos over the main video track. Resize and position them however you like. Play them side by side. Create Audio Tracks from Video Clips Extract audio from videos to use in your project. Play the audio of a video before the video appears for more creative transitions. Blur Effect Apply blur to censored parts of your video. Add Music Tracks Add songs from Music or Files. Trim songs to use only the segment you want. Auto-Sync music with the main video track. Adjust volume levels. Mute the main video audio track while the song plays. Add fade in and fade out for smooth transitions. Add Sound Effects Add sound effects from the included sound effects library. Includes 120 sound effects such as beeps, human noises, animals, ambiences, cartoon sounds, comical effects, vehicles, weapons, explosions, and more. Add Voice-Over Easily record narration for your video. Adjust the volume level. Mute the main video audio track while the recording plays. Add Images Over Video Add images, GIFs, and animated stickers from Photos or Files on top of the video. Add your own watermarks, borders, and overlays. 725953062.name: Track Gear Calculator
725953062.description: Tired of carrying a gear chart to the velodrome every day, or searching the web for one every time you change gears? Then you need a gear calculator on your iPhone and your Apple Watch. Built by track racers for track racers, the Track Gear Calculator supports chainrings from 44 to 70 teeth and cogs from 8 to 20 teeth. It includes a speed/cadence calculator, and can calculate the next gear up or down using only the gears in your track bag. Want a bigger gear or a smaller gear? Track Gear Calculator works in reverse, too: just swipe the gear inches, and you'll get a new gear, up or down from where you are, using only the chainrings and cogs you have with you. You can also select from the standard 27" nominal method for calculating gears, or more accurate actual wheel diameters, and you can see results in either Imperial gear inches or Metric development.

728401013.name: NoteWorks for iPhone
728401013.description: NoteWorks是一款音乐游戏，用来教你学习掌 握认谱和识谱的技能。Hungry Munchy（饥饿 难忍的麦奇）急于吞下难以捉摸的蓝色音符。 你的目标是帮助麦奇尽快获取每一个音符。 游戏集学习和娱乐为一体，给你新奇的体验。 该游戏寓教于乐，界面友好直观，视觉诱人。 NoteWorks对象是： iPhone，iPod touch和iPad用户。 各个年龄段的玩家。 从低年级到高年级音乐专业的学生。 多个爱好音乐的家庭成员。 教授多名学生的音乐教师。 游戏设计特点是： 一个滑稽的动画人物。 用户友好的菜单。 漂亮的图形。 悦耳的声效。 识谱选项： 屏幕上钢琴键盘输入。 屏幕上的吉他指板输入。 MIDI “A，B，C”音符命名: . . . CDEFGAB . . . CDEFGAH . . . ABCDEFG . . . AHCDEFG “do，re，mi”音符命名。 高音谱号。 低音谱号。 次中音谱号。 中音谱号。 自定义音符范围在所有四个谱号。 教育功能特点： 学生在玩游戏的乐趣中学习。 多个游戏设置让玩家掌握控制权。 学生可以选择提示玩。 学生不玩提示获得积分和星星。 学生学习快速识谱。 对初学者，游戏开始学习限定的音符。 注意范围，可轻松定制的学生进步。 学生掌握临时变音记号后，开始学习调号。 游戏速度被控制，以增加或减少困难，或学生可以选择，没有任何时间限制播放。 分享游戏进度：能力与教师分享比赛的结果。 音乐教师总强调的视唱视奏的重要性，大多数教师却仍不想占用课堂的宝贵的时间教授基本识谱技能。因此，NoteWorks帮助音乐教师专注于他们更感兴趣的音乐艺术技巧和乐感等方面。 系统学音乐的学生可以利用该游戏扩充学习自己乐器音域，还可用来备战音乐理论考试。此外，不从事音乐者也可以用NoteWorks作为有趣的训练记忆的游戏，以保头脑的清晰和敏捷。 NoteWork是给那些想寓教于乐的人开发的。 设计难度适中，而且不感到单调乏味。我们希望你在本游戏中有所受益并产生兴趣。请您给我们的游戏打分，分享你的想法和意见，我们将不胜感激。

728573891.name: 专业录音与回放
728573891.description: 不仅仅是录音——更关乎音质、清晰度与时间管理！ “Audio Recorder App”是您的全能录音室，助您捕捉、优化、编辑并安排每一个重要的音频时刻。无论是播客、语音备忘录、音乐会、会议还是讲座，都能以极高清晰度录制。您可以即时消除背景噪音，利用精准编辑工具完善每个文件，并通过内置的录音与回放提醒功能，确保不错过任何重要瞬间。支持云端保存或通过 Wi-Fi/FTP 传输——一切由您做主。 录音 录音时长无限制——经测试支持长达 20 小时的连续录音。 通话或中断后自动恢复录音。 可选择追加录音至现有文件或创建新文件。 静音检测功能：支持自动暂停与自动恢复录音。 输入增益可调；支持蓝牙麦克风。 一键重启或重录。 语音增强 — 即时降噪 一键去除背景噪音，再次点击即可收听原始音频。无需复杂处理，无需等待，即刻见效。 完美应对嘈杂环境——实时清除人群喧哗、风声、嗡嗡声或回声等噪音。 回放时实时生效，让您即刻感受音质提升。 提醒功能 录音提醒 – 灵活设置重复选项，提前安排录音任务。 回放提醒 – 在您需要时准时提醒您回听录音文件。 随时管理、编辑或删除提醒事项。 裁剪与编辑 裁剪 – 仅保留您需要的部分。 擦除 – 即时移除不需要的片段。 音量增强 提升低音量录音的音量，实现更响亮、清晰的回放效果。 语音转文字（离线） 使用我们的免费配套应用“PDF Export”将语音转换为文字——无需连接互联网。 格式与音质 支持 AIFF、WAV、CAF 或 M4A 格式录音。 提供低、中、高（CD 级）或最高（HD 级）音质选项。 位深：支持 16-bit、24-bit 或 32-bit。 输入与输出 支持内置麦克风、蓝牙麦克风或外接麦克风（支持 Tascam iM2）。 快速切换输入与输出设备。 # 录音时长设置 预设时长后自动停止：15、30、60 分钟及更多选项。 播放器 快进与快退控制。 播放速度可调。 直接在播放器内进行剪辑。 连续播放与停止计时器功能。 支持 Apple EarPods 和蓝牙设备。 文件管理 支持 iCloud 同步。 支持文件的复制、移动、重命名、删除、压缩（Zip）及搜索。 可一次性通过电子邮件发送多个录音文件。 查看详细文件信息，并按名称、日期或大小排序。 隐私与安全 设有密码保护文件夹，用于存放敏感录音。 支持应用密码锁。 废纸篓管理 删除的录音会移至废纸篓，可随时恢复。 云存储 支持上传至 Dropbox、OneDrive、Box.net、SugarSync、Evernote 或 WebDAV。 支持从兼容的云服务导入文件。 Wi-Fi 与 FTP 共享 在同一 Wi-Fi 网络下，可通过任意浏览器访问录音。 映射网络驱动器，实现通过 FTP 无线访问文​​件。 主题 深色或浅色模式——随心选择。 更多亮点 支持通过 iPhone Spotlight 搜索查找录音。 支持 3D Touch 快速操作。 喜欢这款应用吗？​​在 App Store 留下简短评价对我们意义重大——这将激励我们不断改进，为您提供更好的体验。谢谢！

729313737.name: Cancer Risk
729313737.description: The Rotterdam Prostate Cancer Risk Calculator is based on ERSPC, Rotterdam, data and supported by the Prostate Cancer Research Foundation, Rotterdam (SWOP) The Prostate Cancer Research Foundation, Rotterdam, Stichting Wetenschappelijk Onderzoek Prostaatkanker (SWOP), is an initiative of the Department of Urology of the Erasmus MC, the University and Medical Centre of Rotterdam, in The Netherlands. Its goal is the financial support of scientific research projects in the field of prostate cancer, as well as other cancers of the urinary tract. Please be aware that the Rotterdam Prostate Cancer Risk Calculator for iOS cannot be 100% accurate at predicting the presence or absence of prostate cancer. It is designed to help calculate your risk, not give a definitive diagnosis. The Rotterdam Prostate Cancer Risk Calculator for iOS provides a general risk calculation based on your PSA level and other information. While knowing your PSA level is helpful, the decision to have a PSA test has to be taken seriously after weighing up all factors and discussing the implications with your GP or hospital doctor. It is possible that prostate cancer will not be found even if you have an elevated PSA. However, it may be present even if your PSA level is low. Your doctor may want to take further tests. If you have doubts or questions about your health, you should always contact your GP or hospital doctor. This is particularly important if you have questions which arise from the use of our prostate cancer risk calculator. It cannot be ruled out that the way the Rotterdam Prostate Cancer Risk Calculator for iOS is used, or the indications given by it, are interpreted in a manner that is not appropriate. The creators of the Rotterdam Prostate Cancer Risk Calculator for iOS do not accept any responsibility in any respect. The European Randomized Study of Screening for Prostate Cancer has published its 11-year follow-up results (New England Journal of Medicine, March 15 2012). Once again, they demonstrate that screening does significantly reduce death from prostate cancer. The latest study confirms that a man who undergoes PSA testing will have his risk of dying from prostate cancer reduced by 29%. ERSPC is the world’s largest randomized prostate cancer screening study. It was designed to investigate whether early detection and treatment of prostate cancer might reduce disease-specific mortality and also help to identify men at risk. From 1992, the ERSPC study randomized 162,000 men, aged 55 to 69, across Europe to either a screening arm or a control group. Designed and developed for iOS by Nuno Azevedo of Ydeal.net Software LDA

Perfect for Education and Classroom Video Projects Trusted by thousands of schools worldwide, Green Screen by Do Ink is one of the most popular education apps for the iPad and iPhone. Ideal for: Student video projects Digital storytelling Book reports and history reenactments Science and STEM presentations School news broadcasts Language learning videos Creative arts integration The intuitive interface makes it easy for elementary, middle and high school students to create polished videos independently. That's why it was named a "Best New App in Education" and a winner of a "Best App for Teaching and Learning" by the American Association of School Librarians. Designed for Creators of All Ages Simple drag-and-drop video layering Import photos and videos from your camera roll or cloud storage Create custom animations No ads No in-app purchases No wifi needed Safe for classrooms and shared devices Whether you are a teacher or student who wants to create interesting visual presentations or a creator producing short films, tutorials, or social videos, Green Screen by Do Ink gives you high quality visual tools without the learning curve. Create Move Magic Anywhere With just an iPad or iPhone, you can produce stunning green screen videos, immersive presentations, and creative storytelling projects from anywhere. 730712765.name: ATO Vehicle Logbook
730712765.description: ATO Vehicle Log book is fully compliant with Australian Tax Office requirements where the logbook method is used to claim the percentage business use of a vehicle. multiple vehicles. choose icon to represent vehicle. multiple logbook periods. calculates & reports your % business use. editing of existing trip records. publishes CSV files. record journey reasons and description, and optional time Send your log directly to your employer, accountant or tax agent. You do not need to perform any additional calculations or spreadsheet manipulations. And can easily be pasted into an Excel spreadsheet You can claim the cost of this app in your tax return. It is a legitimate expense and is fully tax deductible. The ATO requires a logbook be kept for a continuous 12 week period. As long as this period is representative of the normal business use of the vehicle it remains valid for five years ( for further information refer to the ATO website ). This app is also suitable for use in other countries where car logbooks are kept for tax purposes e.g. New Zealand, UK (Company Vehicles benefits-in-kind), Canada, South Africa, Ireland, Netherlands, France, Canada etc. The application can also be used by employees who use their own vehicle for work related travel and need to submit KM reimbursement claims to their employers.

731781859.description: Designed for maximum clarity and ease of use and optimised for latest iOS releases - All the essential Australian weather information from the Bureau of Meteorology - presented quickly, clearly and elegantly - plus powerful and unique new features! BASIC FEATURES: Forecasts - so you know what to expect for the week ahead, in beautifully colourful, clear and readable presentation Current Weather - so you know what is happening now (for ALL your nearby locations) Animated Radar - so you know where it is raining, and whether it is heading your way (with animated radar image loops), also now fully zoomable, with crosshairs centred on your own location Tide data and graphs For hundreds of primary and secondary tide sites around Australia Widget on the Notifications screen - with 4 in-app options for forecast format Watch app with complications Further details... 7 day forecasts for more than 500 official forecast locations Detailed local observations for more than 800 locations, typically updated every 10 mins Each forecast location includes up to 10 nearest official observation locations, accessible by side-scrolling action. 50+ rain radar locations around Australia PREMIUM FEATURES - !!!NEW - THESE ARE NOW AVAILABLE TO ALL USERS!!! These more advanced features are now available to all users (additional in-app purchases no longer required). Hourly Forecasts - hour by hour forecast of temperature, wind and probability of rain Recent Weather - graphs and tabulations of most recent 72hrs (3 days) of weather history Push Notifications Local warnings alerts NEW and UNIQUE to this app - Weather Alarms!!! For example when the temperature crosses any threshold, like 35C Or the windspeed, or amount of rain, or humidity level, etc... Lots More Features (just some of many..!) 732245213.name: Voice Analyst: 音高与音量
732245213.description: 说话时实时查看您的音高和音量 — 录制、测量、跟踪您的声音，适用于言语治疗、嗓音训练和唱歌。 Voice Analyst 已在超过 180 个国家的言语治疗诊所、研究中心、大学及家庭中使用，累计录音超过 1200 万次。 荣获数字健康奖（Medilink SW Healthcare Innovation）。 被收录于 Parkinson's UK 科技指南： https://techguide.parkinsons.org.uk/catalogue/voice-analyst 一次购买，通用于 iPhone、iPad 和 Mac。无需订阅。 测量您的声音 说话或唱歌时，实时查看音高（以赫兹或音符显示）和音量的曲线图。 录制您的声音，并在回放时同步显示音高与音量曲线。 查看任意录音或其中任意片段的统计数据：音高与音量各自的最小值、最大值、平均值和范围。 设定音高和音量目标，即时看到您的声音是否在目标范围内。 放大录音的任意部分进行详细分析，并可单独保存任意片段。 支持 iPad 分屏浏览与多任务处理。 专为言语治疗设计 使用言语治疗师设定的目标在就诊间隙练习 — 包括帕金森病 LSVT LOUD 等课程所用的响度目标。 通过保存的录音和统计数据长期跟踪进展。 可在诊所、家中或远程医疗会话中使用。 与治疗师分享 通过电子邮件将录音和统计数据发送给言语治疗师，也可通过信息和 AirDrop 分享。 将录音保存到设备，或保存至 iCloud、Dropbox 等云存储。 将统计数据复制到电子表格，用于记录、报告和研究。 谁在使用 Voice Analyst 在诊所和远程医疗中测量客户音高与响度的言语治疗师。 正在接受嗓音治疗的人 — 帕金森病、中风、脑损伤、构音障碍、声带麻痹、肌紧张性发声障碍及其他嗓音问题。 借助清晰音高反馈训练声音的跨性别及非二元性别人士。 监测并提升自己声音的歌手、演员、教师和主持人。 需要客观测量声音的研究人员和学生。 隐私保护设计 除非您选择分享，录音始终保存在您的设备上。 不会向我们的服务器上传任何内容 — 客户录音始终由临床工作者掌控。 符合 GDPR — 不收集任何个人数据。 支持离线使用 — 随时随地录音和分析。 用户评价 "能非常轻松地查看音高、设定目标范围、录制和分析录音，以及导出和导入录音。没有这个应用，我无法想象如何训练我的声音。" "我一直在与跨性别客户一起使用 Voice Analyst。它非常易用，频率的可视化显示出色，还能即时分析音高范围和平均值。客户可以在治疗中使用，有些还下载到家里练习。" "非常喜欢这个应用。操作如此简单，却包含了帮助我自我监测、保持动力所需的全部技术。" Voice Analyst 不是医疗器械 — 它测量并录制您的声音，不诊断或治疗任何疾病。如果您担心自己的嗓音质量，请就医并请求转诊至耳鼻喉（ENT）专科医生。 有问题或建议？请发送电子邮件至 support@speechtools.co — 我们非常期待您的来信。

733144754.name: Pinbox - Map Your World
733144754.description: Featured by Apple in “Best New Apps”! Plan your next trip, mark places you want to go, and remember your favorite spots. Across town or across the world, you’ll never forget another place with Pinbox! Add pins where you are, where you’ve been, or where you want to go. Pinbox makes it easy to quickly record and organize your important places into distinct maps for every activity, occasion, or geographic region. Unlike other apps, Pinbox doesn’t force you to save all your places on a single map. You can make one map for your favorite local restaurants - make another map for your next business trip or vacation - and make another map for errands you need to run this weekend. The possibilities are endless! Pinbox is about you and your places. It’s not a social network. You don’t have to create an account or enter your Facebook details to use the app. Your maps aren’t cluttered with random places bookmarked by strangers. Pinbox is simply the best app for privately bookmarking places that are important to YOU! FEATURES Simple, easy-to-use interface Drop a pin for each place you want to remember Add photos, notes, and other details to each pin Choose from seven different pin colors Organize your pins into separate maps See your location in relation to your pins Send maps to other Pinbox users Send pins to Apple Maps, Google Maps, Waze, or Transit for directions Display maps in Standard, Hybrid, or Satellite Save up to 5,000 pins total EXAMPLES OF MAPS YOU MIGHT CREATE Travel planning Favorite restaurants or restaurants to try Customer locations/sales calls Friends and family locations Real Estate listings Favorite hiking/biking trails Secret fishing spots Dog-friendly places Parking spots Favorite stores Multi-stop errands Potential photoshoot locations The list goes on and on and on… Still not convinced? Here are a few of our favorite reviews… “Pinbox is one of those simple apps that does one thing so well it feels frictionless”. Stephen Grassie “The interface is gorgeous - I would say that it looks like something Apple designed”. Macaddict “I have been using this to keep track of all the places the kids and I go so they can see how spread out our world is and they can see where all we have gone. Will use it forever”. 1Cool Daddy “This app is extremely useful and so simple to use. A lifesaver for keeping track of locations”. Davies Photo “I love this app. It is exactly what it claims to be. I have wanted this app since the smartphone was invented. So simple, and so many uses”. T1Man Using Pinbox on an iPod Touch or an iPad: Like other map apps, Pinbox uses GPS to determine your location. iPods and Wi-Fi-only iPads do not have a GPS receiver. On these devices, Pinbox provides your approximate location using information based on your proximity to known Wi-Fi networks (when on and available). The more accurate the available information, the smaller the circle identifying your position on the map. This feature is not available in all areas. Known Wi-Fi networks are predominantly in urban areas. An internet connection is required to load maps, look up addresses, and search. Although Pinbox can be installed on iPads, it’s not formatted for the larger iPad screen - it runs doubled like all other iPhone apps. Pinbox is the result of a collaboration between Scott D. Smith and Paul Burd. We sincerely hope you like it!

733823646.name: 我，等待
733823646.description: “我等待”这个应用是一个可触摸的故事。这个故事由一条象征生命的红线触发，慢慢延申，拉长，连续不断，一直到结束。 这是一个所有年龄段的人都可以阅读的故事。虽然简单，但是却饱含感情，是一个值得分享的故事。 由塞尔治·布洛奇和大卫·加利联合撰写的图文小说改编，“我等待”这个应用将动画情节和互动感巧妙融合，带您享受一个“可以摸得到的故事”。 通过视频引导，读者们会跟随着眼前这条红线慢慢探索故事情节的发展。用手指轻轻触碰它，就可以打开故事世界的大门。 阅读者用朗朗上口的语言陪伴读者，他的声音赋予主人公生命。伴随着音乐和原创插曲，故事里的布景装饰，跌宕起伏，多种气氛，故事情节的能量迸发都被衬托得恰到好处。

734185551.name: PDF to Keynote by PDF2Office
734185551.description: PDF to Keynote by PDF2Office converts your PDF to editable Keynote files on your iPhone. Convert PDF to Keynote documents instantly with a simple tap. Convert the entire document, range of pages or select and mark specific areas in a page to convert using the Area Select tool and have it editable on your iPhone! PDF to Keynote converts PDF files to fully editable Keynote files by recreating the intended construction and layout of the document. PDF to Keynote forms paragraphs; applies styles; re-groups independent graphic elements; extracts images and creates tables automatically. PDF to Keynote also provides detailed options for fine-tuning the conversion process. Every page in a PDF file is converted to an equivalent slide in the resulting Keynote file. PDF to Keynote comes with a fully integrated PDF viewer allowing you to view the file you want to convert. Features Convert PDFs to editable Keynote files Read PDF Files using the integrated PDF viewer Mark just the area within a page to convert. You can convert the marked area to Keynote, JPEG or PNG images even Select an area and have the contents embedded into a new Mail automatically Cloud services integration allows you to transfer files between your Dropbox/OneDrive/GoogleDrive account Use WIFI transfer mode to transfer files between your computer and iPhone Use standard Pinch in/Pinch Out to change the viewing magnification Use the all in 1 interface to Convert and View PDF files. The converted result is easily editable in Keynote Transfer your converted files to any other software on the iPhone that can accept Keynote files. Recosoft is the developer of PDF2Office the de-facto PDF conversion software for the Mac and iPad; PDF2ID the PDF-to-InDesign converter and ID2Office, the InDesign to Word/PowerPoint tool. Refer to our web site to view the entire desktop line of products that we are now bringing to the iOS. Note: PDF to Keynote by PDF2Office does not perform Optical Character Recognition. An image in a PDF file is treated as an image.

734464614.description: 与星座、塔罗牌并列西方三大神秘学！ 每天，数字都包围着我们的生活，但你有没有想过它们是如何影响我们呢？ 其中对我们生命有着最基本而直接的影响，必定是每一个人的出生日期 – 生命数字 – 影响我们生命有很大的影响的数字。 生命密码可以為您带来 : 1，让你清晰的瞭解自己的优缺点、天生稟赋和人生课题…… 2，让你成為最好的老闆和领导，更好的了解员工、激励员工、使用员工…… 3，让你洞悉他人的心理动机、价值观观，和情感沟通点 …… 4，让你能让你成為最好的父母亲，了解孩子的情感需求、天赋和问题……

736244016.name: Starfall Numbers
736244016.description: Explore numbers through the magic of curiosity and the power of motivation: the Starfall way! With this app, your child will learn to recognize number symbols and values by connecting them to real-world objects (such as 1 sun, 5 fingers, and 10 toes). Your child will then apply these concepts with counting activities and songs! Starfall Numbers includes interactive introductions for numbers 0-20, 25, 50, and 100. Counting activities introduce coins, math symbols, and simple expressions while building counting skills from 0 to 100 in entertaining and practical ways. Your child will also enjoy singing along with 15 Starfall math songs! Counting song favorites and calendar concepts are animated playfully, with a closed caption option to display song lyrics. Each activity and song reinforces simple language and basic vocabulary, making this app an excellent choice for pre-readers, emerging readers, and English language learners alike.
