852694885.name: My Little Pony: Fluttershy
852694885.description: The Cutie Mark Crusaders are going to Fluttershy’s cottage for a sleepover tonight and you’re invited to come along! Fluttershy soon finds she has her hooves full as Scootaloo, Apple Bloom, and Sweetie Belle look for ways to earn their hidden talents – their Cutie Marks - by helping Fluttershy. By the end of the night, it isn’t their hidden talents they discover but Fluttershy’s! Read along as the fillies learn a valuable lesson about listening and having patience. Based on the episode Stare Master from the hit animated series FRIENDSHIP IS MAGIC, this adapted story is perfect for early and emerging readers! MY LITTLE PONY: FLUTTERSHY’S FAMOUS STARE is the newest, highly interactive storybook app from PlayDate Digital. A springtime fable that is perfect and appropriate for preschoolers, this new storybook app is designed to help emergent readers practice their skills while following the adventures of their favorite characters. Key Features: TV quality animations Favorite young fillies— Scootaloo, Sweetie Belle and Apple Bloom!—take over Fluttershy’s cottage! Tap on each scene to bring the ponies and the story to life! 18 fully interactive scenes come to life as children tap and explore each page ‘Read to me’ and ‘read along’ modes for every level of early readers New and advanced words are highlighted, sounded out on each page and given meaning through animations. Includes a ‘sight word’ practice section. Parents can track children’s learning progress. Learning Goals: This app can provide an exciting opportunity for preschoolers to gain different skills in the following areas: Early and emergent literacy New vocabulary Expanding early reading skills Increasing reading comprehension Social Emotional Learning Social/relationship skills – Learning the importance of listening to trusted adults. Responsible decision-making – Understanding of responsible decision making

856044755.name: Green Smoothies by Young & Raw
856044755.description: 10,000's of people have taken the Young and Raw 30 Day Green Smoothie Challenge. With this new version of the app, it's easier than ever to integrate a healthy green smoothie in to your daily routine. Get all the vitamins, minerals and fibres your body needs. You'll feel the difference with the Young and Raw 30 Day Green Smoothie Challenge. How does it work? It's simple. One smoothie per day, for 30 days. It can be used as a compliment to your ordinary diet. Each day, you can set a reminder to get your daily recipe. Our 5-day shopping lists, along with checklist style shopping cart, make buying the ingredients you'll need easy. As part of the challenge, we also invite you to join our private Facebook group where we encourage everyone to share pictures of their smoothies and stories of how they're getting along with the challenge. The smoothies can help boost your immune system, energise you and even help shed excess weight. Each one has a detailed description of the health benefits of the different ingredients. We also have a section covering additional superfoods you can add to your smoothies. In total, inside the app you'll find 120 simple green smoothie recipes. When you complete the challenge, you can either re-start it, or dream up your own adventure, by browsing through the smoothie menu we have. Here is a selection of the 120 smoothie recipes you’ll have access to: + Skin Booster Smoothie + Super Inflammation Buster + Clean Green Energy Smoothie + Peach Perfect Ginger Delight + Antiviral Orange Booster + Spiced Iron Rich Smoothie + Vitamin K Booster To prepare the smoothies you'll need a blender. We've rounded up our top selections inside the app. When we launched the 30 Day Green Smoothie Challenge app in May, 2014, it hit the top of the Food and Drink charts in 52 countries. This fully updated new edition makes it easier than ever to take the challenge and discover our green smoothie recipes. Who are Young and Raw? Young and Raw is a place for people to learn about the healing and cleansing benefits of raw and whole foods. Our team of nutritionists, naturopaths, herbalists and other qualified individuals assist in the creation of our programs. "Our mission is to inspire millions around the world to join the Real Food Movement!" Founders of YoungandRaw.com

861216052.name: Gridplay
861216052.description: Make quality quick-cut style music videos straight from your phone with Gridplay. Giving even the most experienced filmmakers a new experience, the innovative grid screen allows users to combine and divide cells at will in order to create dynamic videos. Add a song, trim clips, and adjust and scale each cell for extra flair. Turn your inspirational moments into the movie of your life with Gridplay. Features: 1. Takes up to 16 4x4 videoclips (These can be recorded or uploaded.) 2. Swipe to combine or divide the cells 3. Create and edit a timeline with multiple frames 4. Optimized for low-resolution (640p) on Instagram 5. Records up to 15 seconds. (5 minutes with extension) 6. Self-timer 7. Each clip has an independent sound control 8. Ability to save video to camera roll 9. Frame thickness and color settings 10. Automatically saves rough draft 11. Rotate, adjust, scale, and mirror each clip 12. Share to Vine Instructions: 1. Pick a cell and choose the camera mode. (Full screen vs. split screen, and back camera vs. front camera) 2. Swipe to combine cells, and swipe again to divide. 3. Press the "Film" button. 4. Set the timer up to 15 seconds. (If you have unlocked the extension, you can set the timer up to 5 minutes.) 5. When you finish with one frame, it will go to the next automatically. You need to set the timer for each frame. 6. If you don't like what you have recorded, tap to delete. If you don't want to fill up the other cells? No problem, just go to the next step. 7. Adjust the volume and position of each clip. 8. Trim the clips and add background music. 9. Save and share on Vine, Instagram, Facebook, Youtube, Tumblr, and email.

861969994.name: Audio RTA
861969994.description: Audio RTA is a real-time octave RTA analyzer. It gives you a visual representation of an acoustic signal. It can be used to measure the frequency response of audio equipment or to analyze the sounds of musical instruments. Features Octave RTA analyzer: bands - full, 1/3, 1/6, 1/12 (RMS values) SPL Meter (dBFS) Fast real-time response Sampling rates: 44.1kHz, 48kHz, 96kHz* Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) Window sizes: 256, 512, 1024, 2048, 4096, 8192, 16384, 32768, 65536 Max/min values Zoom and pan Measure values Audio input can be supplied via the built-in microphone and an external microphone (via the USB camera adapter or through the iPhone/iPad dock connector – Core Audio compliant devices) Sharing charts (through mail, social networks, clipboard) Exporting image charts (png) to the iOS 11 Document Browser (supports iCloud) SPL meter weighting: dBZ - linear For 96kHz analysis use an external microphone with such capabilities through a USB camera adapter or through the iPhone/iPad dock connector.

862112892.name: Hooktheory I
862112892.description: Embark on a musical journey! Follow the Hooktheory Book Series in a smart, fun, skill-building journey. Learn how to craft melodies and chord progressions like professional musicians, and discover an intuitive and deep understanding of how music works. Validated by over 30,000 hobby and pro musicians like you, the Hooktheory Book Series is the best-selling how-to series for musicians around the world for a reason. Hooktheory I isn’t like other music theory books. Hooktheory teaches with an easy-to-understand music format that emphasizes chord and melody function. Rich audiovisual animations play along as you learn. We dissect popular songs and show you how the pros do it. Immediately practice concepts and tactics with our companion musical sketchpad, Hookpad. There is nothing else like it! Fun to read. Easy to understand. Full of practical knowledge. Learn from 41 interactive exercises and 88 audiovisual examples from artists like The Beatles, Journey, Taylor Swift, Beyoncé, Adele, Coldplay, Billy Joel, Lady Gaga, Elton John, Maroon 5, and more! In Hooktheory I, you’ll learn the following skills: Composing music based on a scale. Understanding the six basic chords that underlie all great chord progressions. Writing chord progressions based on function (understanding which chords go together and which ones don’t) Making melodies “chord aware” - learn why certain melodies sound good with a chord progression and why others don't Controlling the natural tension and release in melodies over a chord progression Benefits: Simple piano roll notation (sheet music knowledge not required) Every concept + technique demonstrated through an actual song 88 audiovisual examples from artists like The Beatles, Journey, and Taylor Swift Reinforce learning at every step with 41 exercises Designed to be used with Hookpad Music Making Software. Hookpad lets you practice every concept and tactic you learn in the books immediately To sum it up, Hooktheory I will teach you the essential basic techniques for crafting effective and compelling chord progressions and melodies. Reading Hooktheory I doesn’t require any previous music knowledge or the ability to read sheet music. On average, it takes about five hours to read so it isn't a huge time commitment. Dedicate only a few hours to reading this book and gain a lifetime of skills that will give your music that professional edge.

862347495.description: 【經典級文法書】文法重點條例化，解說清晰易懂***** 您上過英文補教名師－賴世雄老師的文法課嗎？如果您未能恭逢賴老師堂堂爆滿的精彩課程，那絕對不能錯過這套《賴世雄英文文法》課程。 App內包含《賴世雄英文文法》全書1-14章的文字內容與第1章的語音講解，第2章以後的語音講解必須在App內加購與下載！***** 《賴世雄英文文法》全書1-14章，以淺顯易懂的文字解說，帶您一路輕鬆掌握學習文法的樂趣，成為人人稱羨的英文高手！如果您想進一步加強印象，可以加購《講解版》，聽賴老師在風趣幽默中，漫談重要文法觀念，用最淺顯易懂的教學方式，讓讀者用耳朵聽，也能輕鬆領略英文文法規則的全貌。 除了鉅細靡遺的解說外，每一章均提供測驗練習，每題均附解答與詳解，極利於想把英文文法徹底學好的人士使用。本書可說是坊間最容易學習、也最容易吸收的最佳英文文法參考書，值得親愛的讀者細細品味。 【內容特色】 1.從單字造句出發：揚棄傳統的八大詞類分項解說，讓讀者立即認識主詞及動詞，明瞭單句造句的基本原則。 2.細談連接詞用法： 使讀者明白連接詞及關係詞的用法，進而熟悉複句或複雜句造句方式。 3.詳解動狀詞結構： 使讀者了解分詞、不定詞、動名詞的形式及用法，完全掌握句構分析能力。 4.搭配有聲講解版： 賴世雄老師與台大教授Karen Chung老師，針對全書內容旁徵博引的講解，讓讀者隨時隨地『聽』英文文法，以加強印象。（第二章以後講解，需加購） 請注意：講解內容並非依照書本內容逐句完整講解，但十分精采，搭配內容學習，效果更佳！ 【學習功能】 1.提供iPhone/iPad閱讀模式：讓您在使用裝置中，擁有最好的閱讀模式。 2.目錄條理分明：分14章，400則以上文法解析，條目分明，內容豐富。 3.搜尋：輸入關鍵字即可查找想學習了解的內容。 4.書籤：將重要學習內容標以書籤，方便日後反覆復習。 5.筆記：學習過程中，可做筆記；按章節排列筆記順序，方便查閱。 6.字體：可依需求週整字體大小。 ●　客服聯絡：如對產品有任何想法或建議，或者使用上遭遇問題，都歡迎和我們聯絡－ 1. 客服信箱：welcome@mail.soyong.com.tw 2. 客服電話：請於上班時間來電02-77210772轉510 3. 客服留言板：http://www.mebook.com.tw/iPhone/SupportTC.asp 我們一定竭誠為您服務。

862447693.name: Pocket Wiki for Terraria
862447693.description: Looking for help or the latest tips for the game Terraria? This all-in-one solution is exactly what you need: everything for the good game and improving your gaming skills. This app will be useful for both novice and experienced players. No ads! It does not require an internet connection to use so that any relevant information is always available to you. This app is unofficial. See what reviewers say about this app: “BEST WIKI EVER!!! - It's easy access and always updating to the most the most current Terraria update. Great organization and it's super easy to find everything you need. Gives you every recipe to the game in case you forget or don't know how to craft something. Having trouble defeating a boss? Get vital information and helpful tips in the wiki!! Couldn't have created a better one." by Pie 3000)$$ “Amazing - I love this app, its basically a wiki, that doesn't need internet, its sorted where you can find everything. Best Terraria app I own, love this app!!" by 2 EPIC for name! “Amazing and handy - This app is amazing I hardly right reviews but this app deserves it. I like this app cause it doesn't need wifi and it's all useful information and good to have when I need to fight a boss and stuff." by Roxas2488 "Best terraria guide I've ever seen - This is the best terraria guide I've ever seen. Sure it needs some stuff to be added but its still the best" by Just my opinion don't hate "Good app - Very complete app. I recommend. Just the layout of the screen is strange sometimes, but the info provided is awesome.Congratulations to the developer." by MilnitZ_ "Great app - This app helped me a ton when I would get stuck on how to craft something and gave me great tips on how to beat bosses." by Deadlyviper696 "Well made. Good app - It's a really nice app. My bro told me about it. I use it whenever I'm stuck in a place and it's a lot easier than going to the online wiki(s). I definitely suggest you try it out for your self. :)" by Surprised kitty "Good - I think this app is really helpful and actually works offline. I just hope that this app keeps up to date thank you for finally make an app like this please keep updating and keep up the good work." by AgentGoldfire "Extremely Helpful - As a new player to the console version of this game this guide is great for learning about new things…” by Honeycombs96 ● Features: Achievements Biomes Crafting Drop Enemies IDs Ingredients Items Items sold Living preferences News about the game NPCs Recipes Videos Walkthrough A dark theme All objects are interrelated, for example, by looking at a recipe to create an object, you can immediately go to an ingredient, and then go back or open some other object Easy navigation through the app Search by text Search for an object by name The ability to add/remove objects to/from favorites The ability to customize the size and type of the font, the choice of different color themes viewing the text Zoom images or text Works offline Any requests, suggestions, and comments, please send via the "Feedback" in the app or email me at kateryna.momotova@yahoo.com. I will be happy and motivated if you leave a positive review of my work. Thanks! :) ● Note This app is unofficial and not affiliated with the game’s developer, publisher, or distributor. All in-game content, imagery, text, and videos on the application are copyrighted by their respective owners. This reference app is for informational purposes and meant to assist fans of this game with gameplay, and is intended to be used alongside the game. It can contain information obtained from free sources on the internet. If you have a concern or feel there is a direct copyright or trademark violation that does not fall within "fair use" guidelines, please email directly me at kateryna.momotova@yahoo.com to discuss this.

862471845.name: 台球量杆高手，学习台球、桌球、斯诺克的完美推杆动作
862471845.trackName: 台球量杆高手，学习台球、桌球、斯诺克的完美推杆动作
862471845.description: 您想提高您的斯诺克/台球技术吗？想获得单杆更高分？想赢得更多比赛？ 这一切的起点是，您要掌握您球杆的运动... 台球量杆高手(CueMeasure)是在世界上的顶级教练的帮助下开发的一款应用程序： 它能帮助您追踪球杆的运动，当您击球时它可以监测到； 之后它能利用启发式算法详细分析您每一个击球的动作； 随后本应用会对您击球动作的各方面表现打分（手腕旋转、与桌面保持平行、左右旋转...） 在您训练期间，本应用会追踪您的不同击球动作并评出一个总分； 如果检测到不应该做的击球动作，它会自动向您发出提醒； 此外,台球量杆高手还有更多高级用途，如实时图片显示球杆的运动（比如您是否在即将击球之前抬起了手肘？） 台球量杆高手可以完美地独自工作，但它也支持网络模式/教练模式，在这种模式下所测得的球杆运动信息会实时传递到其他iPhone/iPad设备上（通常是后者）。您的朋友或教练就可以实时观察您的动作表现； 台球量杆高手是世界上的顶级教练使用的软件，用来迅速查找球杆运动的问题帮帮您解决； 当您用这个简单的软件就可以让技术提高一大截时，您有必要购买那些昂贵的设备吗？ 请注意，您可以在iPad上安装台球量杆高手的教练模式，但是实际测量球杆运动时您需要使用iPhone 我们致力于不断地更新台球量杆高手，新功能会源源不断地开发出来。, 关注我们吧！

862773459.name: Noisli
862773459.description: Noisli.com 的官方应用程序- 适用于工作和放松的背景噪声和色彩生成器。高品质的周围环境声音，帮助你在工作里集中注意力，缓解焦虑，并且在你的冥想或瑜珈课程里也能有所帮助。它也能在你看书时或临睡前帮助你放松。 Noisli主要是用于淹没恼人的噪音，以使注意力能够更好地被集中和提高生产力。它也能制造愉快的音频环境，非常适用于放松或有助睡眠。 当你在一个 开放式的办公室里工作，并且四周都是大声说话的同事，这是否导致你不能专注？当你在家里或图书馆里工作学或学习时，你是否总是打不起精神？当你一直都在飞机上或火车上的旅途中，你是否需要小睡并闭目养神？ Noisli使你的生活变得更轻松，并在长时间的办公时间或紧凑的学习课程里让你保持清醒。 新闻与媒体 The Next Web – “The perfect tool to help get you more productive in the comfort of your own home” Time – “Noisli helps you tackle busywork” FastCompany – “12 Tech Tools Productivity Experts Can’t Live Without” Cnet – “Relax during your stressful workday with Noisli. It is pure simplicity” LifeHacker – “Noisli Generates Background Sounds to Keep You Creative and Relaxed” 此应用程序也使用于许多其它情况，如对失眠有所帮助，在你阅读时让你更加放松，减轻压力，舒缓头痛和偏头痛，或在水疗里的按摩过程都有所帮助。它也能协助父母让宝宝入睡。 Noisli也可用来掩蔽耳鸣并对于ADD（注意力缺失症）和ADHD（注意力缺陷多动障碍）皆有帮助。 Noisli可以改善你的健康，让您感觉更好。 此服务已在世界各个角落里被编码员，程序员，博主，作家，学生以及工作中的翻译员或在创意写作课课程里的老师使用。 它是如何操作的 你可以通过混合不同的声音来创建为你本身量身定制的完美声音氛围，以满足个人的需求和品位。 请激活一种或多种声音并调节音量滑块来创建一个多样化和悦耳的声音环境。 有了Noisli，你可以提升你的注意力，加强生产力或只是躺下来，聆听，并享受渐入梦境的过程。 声音 雨声、雷鸣，风声、森林鸟鸣声，树叶沙沙声、溪流声、海滨海鸥飞翔以及让你心情放松的海浪声、水流声、壁炉声、夏夜里猫头鹰和蟋蟀鸣叫声，风扇声、隆隆火车声、咖啡店背景声、白色噪声、粉红色噪声、棕色噪声。 永远伴随着你——离线声 此应用程序Noisli让你在下线的情况下也一样能播放所有的声音，因此你总是可以享受它的功能和好处，即使是在飞机上或火车上，或在任何其它不需要互联网连接的活动里也一样。 创建并保存你的精彩组合 播放和混合声音以找到你最喜欢的组合 - 并把它们保存起来。这样一来，你随时都能重播这些组合。 同步连接 现在，你可以注册一个免费的Noisli账户，以让你的精彩组合能在你所有的设备上总是同步。你需要网络连接以便能完成同步。 带有声效渐弱功能的定时器 使用该定时器功能，你可以利用如番茄工作法等有效的时间管理方法，在减少干扰和防止过度劳累的同时提高效率和生产力。 你可以在工作，学习或创意课程里使用内置的倒计时功能。你也可以将此功能作为一个睡眠定时器，让你能够享受轻松的午觉或放松地入睡。 背景音频支持 你在使用其他应用程序或上网游览网站的同时，也能够享受这美妙的音频。 关注我们 Facebook: https://facebook.com/Noisli Twitter: https://twitter.com/Noisli Website: https://www.noisli.com

863565223.name: Molecule World
863565223.description: Molecule World A modern molecular visualization app for iPhone, iPad, and Mac. Molecule World is back — completely redesigned for Apple's modern ecosystem. Developed, in part, with funding from the National Science Foundation* and recognized for its contributions to science education, Molecule World has been rebuilt from the ground up as a single, unified app for iPhone, iPad, and Mac (via Mac Catalyst). The new version pairs high-quality molecular visualization with a streamlined experience that follows you across every device. Explore Molecular Structures in 3D Students, educators, and researchers can interactively explore proteins, DNA, RNA, and small molecules in a fully three-dimensional environment. Rotate, zoom, and pan through structures with smooth, high-quality rendering built for clarity and scientific understanding. Bring In Structures From the Major Databases Open files you already have, or fetch structures right inside the app — search the Protein Data Bank, PubChem, and NCBI by ID or keyword and have them download and open in seconds. Connect Sequences to Structure and Function on iPad and Mac The sequence viewer (iPad & Mac) makes it easy to see the number and kind of sequences in a structure — protein, DNA, and RNA — along with its heterogens: modified amino acids and nucleotides within a sequence, and external organic and inorganic molecules such as ligands and ions. Each sequence is colored to match your current view. Powerful Visualization Tools Smooth, interactive 3D — rotate, zoom, and pan Multiple representation styles: ball-and-stick, space-filling, tubes, ribbon/cartoon, molecular surfaces, and wire mesh Focused selections — show just proteins, nucleic acids, ligands, backbones, or alpha-carbon traces Scientific color schemes — by element, chain, residue, secondary structure, charge, hydrophobicity, and B-factor Clear, context-aware legends that explain exactly what you're looking at Designed for Education and Discovery Molecule World is used in classrooms and laboratories to support teaching in structural biology, chemistry, and molecular science. Educators can illustrate key concepts — protein folding, molecular interactions, and the structure of DNA and RNA — with visuals students manipulate themselves. Built for the Apple Ecosystem One app runs natively on iPhone, iPad, and Mac. Optional iCloud support keeps your library of structures — and your place in them — in sync across all your devices. Built for What's Next This release lays the foundation for upcoming features, including enhanced analysis tools, richer educational workflows, and professional research capabilities. NSF awards IIP 1315426 and DUE 2055036 Molecule World is developed by Digital World Biology LLC.

867478383.description: Save time with this exposure calculator for Iridium-192, Selinium-75 and Cobalt-60 sources. No more need to calculate the formula or use of the "old-school plastic calculator" Simply fill in the thickness, activity(in Curies) and source-film-distance and you get the correct exposure time. R factor for different densities and film types. For materials: Iron(steel), Concrete, Tungsten, Lead, Aluminum, Titanium, Copper, Zinc, Brass, Inconel X, Zirconium and Uranium. Features: Exposure Time calculator Geometric Unsharpness calculator Exposure Correction calculator Decay calculator Barricade calculator Pipe Schedule selector (single/double wall) Weld enforcement setting Iridium 192 Emissivity setting inch/mm setting

868827305.name: Collins Bird Guide
868827305.description: ‘It’s much more convenient than taking a big book with you...the Collins app is fantastic.’ – Chris Packham, Metro ‘The Collins Bird Guide app is destined to become a real triumph, the ultimate in field guide apps — and deservedly so.’ – BirdGuides The Collins Bird Guide App combines world-class illustrations and comprehensive information with intuitive design to create the ultimate field guide for passionate birders and casual birdwatchers alike. The app is based on the landmark book by Lars Svensson, Killian Mullarney and Dan Zetterström, universally acknowledged as the standard European field guide. This definitive work has been reimagined for iPad and iPhone by birders for birders. The Collins Bird Guide App provides everything you need to identify a species quickly and learn about it thoroughly. Immerse yourself in the exceptional illustrations, maps, calls and concise text. Use the powerful search filter and curated confusion lists to focus in on a species. The Collins Bird Guide App is an essential companion always to hand on your iPhone, and available to browse in full glory on your iPad. Features include: 973 species covered - 843 illustrated 3,700+ beautiful illustrations by Killian Mullarney and Dan Zetterström Detailed text covering habitat, range, identification and voice by Lars Svensson Record sightings, location and date with the listing tool Powerful search filter Intuitive design to quickly and easily swipe through species Curated lists of confusable species Over 1,100 carefully selected songs and calls – many by Lars Svensson Select species names from 30+ languages Expertly edited video clips for 811 species in the app (require in-app purchase) Available in English, Swedish, Norwegian, French and German Weighs nothing! Identify Assist is our brand-new subscription service. Instantly identify species from photos and recordings with cutting-edge AI. As well as this and the optional video library, the app incorporates British Trust for Ornithology/BirdWatch Ireland/Scottish Ornithologists' Club Bird Atlas 2007–11 mapping data as an in-app purchase, providing the most comprehensive location mapping of any bird guide app. The latest version of the app requires iOS 17.0 or later. If you like the app, don’t forget to share the app, rate it and leave a review. Privacy Policy natureguides.com/privacy-policy Terms of Use apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

869346854.name: GoCoEdit - Code & Text Editor
869346854.description: GoCodeEditor is a Code Editor optimized for fast opening and editing local and remote files (Dropbox, OneDrive, Google Drive, FTP, SFTP/SSH) on your iOS Device. FEATURES: Sublime like Code-Editor! Universal App (use it on your iPad, iPhone & iPod Touch) iPhone X (s/s Max) support Full iPad Pro support (including smart keyboard support, shortcuts, split-screen multitasking) iPadOS Mouse & Trackpad NEW! Multi-caret Editing NEW! Siri Shortcuts create newfile / start shell / connect to shell / preview more soon... Drag & Drop Support Support for Drag & Drop files from the Files App Support for Drag & Drop files / repos and folders from Working Copy App Support for Dragging local files from GoCoEdit to other Apps Compatible with Apple Watch Start a ssh-shell from your wrist right now! Run your self defined scripts with one tap. Extra keybar with swipe functions and trackball to precisely move the cursor and select text Syntax highlighting for many coding languages like: (apache, arduino, asp/vb.net, c, c#, c++, ceylon, clojure, coffeescript, css, dart, dockerfile, elixir, erlang, fortran, go, handlebars, haskel, html, jade, java, javascript (es6 support), jsx, kotlin, latex/stex, less, lisp, livescript, lua, markdown, mathematica, nginx, objective-c, pascal, perl, php, plist, powershell, pug, puppet, python, r, rss, ruby, rust, sass, scala, shader, shell, sql, squirrel, stylus, svelte, swift, typescript, verilog, vue(js), xml, yaml) Some comfort features: code folding, code hinting, auto indent, auto close brackets, line wrapping, smart indent, tag and bracket matching, find by regular expression, replace, replace all, symbolic/function search for many syntax modes Quick CMD-mode (keep your hands on the On-Screen-Keyboard) p.e. press cmd+c, cmd+v to copy and paste selected text over 15 shortcuts supported Different themes ( include solarized, monokai and many more ) and font-sizes Import / export / open files from icloud drive and other file providers Open entire folders or repositories from the Git client Working Copy or the Files App using the iOS document picker Extendable Custom Syntax Modes -- create your own Syntax highlighting modes now you can write own modes and use it for your own file types Custom Themes -- create your own editor themes Snippets -- use short fragments of text again and again ( with filed and placeholders support ) Preview Browser with Javascript console ( in iPad version resizeable for preview iPad or iPhone layouts ) Markdown Preview & HTML Export Connect to your servers via SFTP, FTP, DRIVE, G-DRIVE, ONEDRIVE or DROPBOX NEW! with OneDrive 365 and OneDrive for Business support NEW! File has changed detection ( GCE is now able to detect external file changes on local and remote files ) Upload and Download files/folders or edit files directly on your server/dropbox/drive/onedrive without download Very fast reconnect and recover of open files after restart Edit your files directly on your server without download. Integrated Shell (ssh) to perform background tasks like a Grunt, Gulp, npm or another shell job ( type direct or define scripts and run it with a single tap ) Supporting advanced features like textselection by cursor, Splitview, Slide-Over and Drag & Drop 3D Touch support Show/move cursor by 3D touch the keyboard Quick Actions (new file, start shell, connect shell to last server, show preview of last file) External/Bluetooth keyboard support ( all iOS shot-cut keys are supported + lots of shortcuts available ) If you want to support the project and increase the development speed become a patreon.

870644777.name: Timesheet - Time Tracker
870644777.description: Timesheet is a time tracking app that makes recording your working time seamless and natural. It helps you manage your life with a clean, simple, and minimalistic design. Easy to use When you start your work, you can input it using the stopwatch. When the work is finished, you can input the time directly. You can enter your data anytime and anywhere you want! Stopwatch and repeating alarm You can set a repeating alarm every 20, 30, 60, 90 minutes. This is very useful tool when you want to concentrate on your work. In Apple Watch, You can receive alarm notification and Start/Stop of stopwatch. Various scenes of the total time You can check the total time on a per day, per project and per tag basis. The time period for the total time can be inputted as 1 day, 1 week, 1 month, 6 months, 1 year and free. The information provided by the app will help you improve your daily activities. Output ・Weekly Report(PDF) ・Monthly Report(PDF) ・Project Report(PDF) ・CSV Save in Calendar This app can save your data in your calendar. With iCloud, you can sync the calendar automatically to your various different devices.

871209106.trackName: Track Kit - GPS Tracker with offline maps
871209106.description: Track Kit is a great GPS tracking and publishing app packed with tons of cool features from Pro version. Instead of paying $4.99 get Track Kit just for $3.99 right NOW! Don't miss the SALE with a lower price! Would you like to explore new places even before you start traveling? Do you want to share travel routes and pictures with your friends? Track Kit – is not only multifunctional tracker but also a unique free web service for exploring, editing and presenting your travel routes. Features: TRACK RECORDING [+] One BIG RED BUTTON for recording your track. [+] LARGE map screen. [+] Quick camera button. [+] Brief statistics can be expanded by vertical swipe on a red panel. [+] (i) button for complete real-time stats and scrollable charts. [+] Segments and splits. [+] Following a pre-loaded track. [+] Appending a pre-loaded track. [+] Multi-color gradients for SPEED, ALTITUDE and VERTICAL SPEED. [+] Follow my location mode - observe current position. [+] Track recording in background. [+] ADVANCED. Energy saving mode. [+] ADVANCED. Recording intervals for track optimization. [+] ADVANCED. Douglas-Peucker track point reduction. [+] ADVANCED. GPS data filters. Recommended ***** v.2.1 - Mar 29, 2015 This app is a must have for travelers, many powerful features and offline maps very useful. Recommended. FREE OFFLINE MAPS The application includes some of the popular maps including Google Maps, Bing, OSM, MapQuest, Yandex, USGS. [+] 16 downloadable map sources from total of 27 providers. [+] Worldwide coverage [+] ADVANCED. Up to 19 zoom levels: select only necessary data to download [+] USGS Topo maps Great ***** v.2.1 -Mar 31, 2015 I have tried this app today and all I can say is WOW. Offline maps is hands down very much needed. Track bearing and distance to labels in real-time MAP TOOLS [+] Search on the map [+] Multipoint distance measurement and radius overlay. [+] Measure distance between points [+] Measure angles and bearing WORKING WITH TRACKS [+] Record [+] Share [+] Search tracks [+] ADVANCED. Compare tracks [+] ADVANCED. Optimize tracks REAL-TIME TRACKING [+] Track your friends in real time (internet connection is required)! SENSOR RECORDING [+] Record sensors! Go to options to select sensors to be recorded. COMPASS [+] Easily navigate to waypoints with the advanced compass. SHARING AND PUBLISHING [+] Publish tracks on www.track-kit.net web site. [+] Share your tracks and pictures with friends via Gmail, Facebook or Twitter. [+] GPX, KML, KMZ file import and export [+] KMZ file can be imported to Google earth WWW.TRACK-KIT.NET web site was created to make sharing of your tracks as easy as possible. Register for FREE to be able to share your tracks with the world! IMPORTANT NOTES. 1.While recording tracks the application uses GPS in background mode. Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life. 2.To keep your tracks stored on the server, please register for FREE at www.track-kit.net. 3.iPod Touch and Wi-Fi only iPads - This application will not be fully functional on these devices, unless you have an external GPS attachment. 872615882.name: 植物 - Tinybop出品
872615882.description: 深入探寻植物王国的奥秘！在这款交互式立体模型中探索世界上的生物群落：变换四季、控制天气、点燃野火，还可以挖洞看到小动物和植物根茎。算法式动画让数十个物种栩栩如生；在这个数字沙盒中的每一次探险都有新惊喜，适合 4-10 岁的儿童。 《植物》是“探索者知识库”系列的第二款 app，该系列是激发探索欲和更深入了解世界的超级游戏集合。Tinybop 屡获殊荣的第一款 app《身体》，在 143 个国家 App Store 的教育 app 榜单排名第 1，并荣获 App Store 2013 最佳 app。 特性 温带森林和沙漠生物群落是《植物》第一版中的内容。现在购买还可免费活动后续推出的两个生物群落：苔原和温带草原。 额外的生物群落即将推出，可通过 app 内购买获得：针叶林、热带稀树草原、红树林和热带雨林。 详尽、准确的插画展示了数十种动植物和它们的自然栖息地。 算法式动画，让每一次探险都有新惊喜。 变换白天、夜晚、季节和年份，随着时间的推移揭开每个生物群落生命周期的奥秘。 观看陆地上和地面下的动植物。 可免费下载的手册（支持 8 种语言）为家长和老师提供学习和互动提示。 轻松在 50 多种语言的标签中切换，包括学名（在您的设备上设置或在显示板中选择语言）。 使用可移除和可粘贴标签学习并确定物种。 数字沙盒鼓励开放探索和学习。 录音工具让孩子们和家长互相问问题。 支持所有 Tinybop app 的通用显示板，让家长能监控孩子们的进度，并查看、保存和分享对话。 设备内置功能包括麦克风和重力感应器可用于营造身临其境的效果。 原创画作和音效设计。 直观、安全和适合儿童使用的界面。 多用户系统：每个孩子能选择并命名他们自己的人物。 所有年龄段都能体验游戏乐趣，从幼儿到成人。 无规则和级别 - 有好奇心就能获得奖励。 手册 为丰富您的学习体验，我们的网站提供免费的手册供您下载，手册中包含大量可交互的趣味事实和指南。《植物》手册下载地址：http://tinybop.com/handbooks. 隐私权政策 我们非常重视您和您的孩子的隐私权。我们不会收集或分享关于您孩子的个人信息，我们也不会允许显示任何第三方的广告。 当摄像头、麦克风和其他服务在 app 中使用 时，您的信息不会被收集，也不会在 app 外部分发。 我们的完整版隐私权政策可在我们的网站上阅读。 关于 Tinybop Tinybop, Inc. 是一家总部设在布鲁克林的工作室，由设计师、开发者和艺术家所组成，专为有着好奇心的孩子们打造教育类 app。 与 Tinybop 一起，引导您的孩子更加深入的了解我们所生活的世界。 阅读新闻和了解最新版本信息 访问网站：www.tinybop.com 关注我们：twitter.com/tinybop 为我们打“赞”：facebook.com/tinybop 幕后一撇：instagram.com/tinybop 我们期待收到您的反馈；请随时提出！如果您有好点子，或有些功能在您看来没法工作，请联系我们：hi@tinybop.com. 兼容 iPhone 4、4s、5、5s、5c，iPod touch（第 5 代），iPad 2、3、mini 和 Air。本 app 已为 iPad 优化。需要 iOS 8 或更新版本。 语言：英语、阿拉伯语、巴斯克语、孟加拉语、保加利亚语、加泰罗尼亚语、中文（简体）、中文（繁体）、捷克语、丹麦语、荷兰语、爱沙尼亚语、菲律宾语、芬兰语、法语、德语、希腊语、海地克里奥尔语、希伯来语、印地语、匈牙利语、冰岛语、印度尼西亚语、意大利语、日语、韩语、拉丁语、拉脱维亚语、马来语、挪威语、波斯语、波兰语、葡萄牙语、旁遮普语、罗马尼亚语、俄语、塞尔维亚语、斯洛伐克语、斯洛文尼亚语、西班牙语、斯瓦希里语、瑞典语、泰米尔语、泰卢固语、泰语、藏语、土耳其语、乌克兰语、维吾尔语、乌尔都语、乌兹别克语和越南语！

872763741.name: 20.20.20: Eye Care & Tracker
872763741.description: Protect Your Vision with Purpose – The New 20.20.20 App Track Progress. Earn Achievements. Stay Focused. Screen time is unavoidable—but digital eye strain doesn't have to be. With a fully redesigned interface and a focus on gamified wellness, the all-new 20.20.20 app helps you build a healthy habit that protects your most valuable sense: your sight. What's New in This Major Update A modern, intuitive interface with full Dark Mode support Powerful achievement system to motivate consistency Enhanced progress tracking for visualizing your improvement Optimized experience across iPhone and Apple Watch Polished UI with a clean, calming visual style The Science-Backed 20.20.20 Rule Every 20 minutes, look away from your screen for 20 seconds at something 20 feet away. It’s a proven method to reduce fatigue, dryness, and long-term strain. Built for Habits, Not Just Reminders Smart haptic alerts gently cue your breaks without interrupting your workflow Custom daily schedules let you decide when reminders are active Visual progress insights help you build and maintain eye-care habits Motivate Yourself with Achievements Unlock meaningful milestones and stay consistent with goal-based rewards: First Break – Complete your first eye exercise Speed Demon – Do 5 exercises in a single day Perfect Week – Meet your daily goals for 7 consecutive days Week Warrior – Complete 50 sessions in a week Time Master – Reach 10 hours of focused work Consistency King – Maintain a 30-day streak Whether you're a student, remote worker, or power user, the 20.20.20 app makes it easy to care for your eyes—while keeping you motivated and engaged. Rebuild your habits. Redesign your focus. Reinforce your vision. Download the 20.20.20 app today and join thousands building healthier screen routines.

872966939.name: 坦克大战 - 迷你战争
872966939.trackName: 坦克大战 - 迷你战争
872966939.description: 这是一个非常经典的学习机坦克游戏。几乎每个人都应该玩过这种类型游戏。 我们修改了学习机坦克，并把它带回21世纪。 “坦克大战- 迷你战争”已是第二代了，第一代是“超级坦克大战”。 “迷你战争”继承了”超级坦克大战”的所有优点，并且增加了许多新的元素。 游戏规则： 防御你的基地 消灭所有敌人坦克 如果你的坦克或基地被摧毁，游戏便会结束 游戏特点： 5个不同的难度级别（从易到疯狂） 3个不同的游戏区（正常、危险、噩梦） 6种不同类型敌人坦克 您的坦克可以上升3个等级 辅助坦克，现在你可以命令它原地警戒 许多不同类型的地图物件，你可以在截图看到 每个地图物件都可以破坏 4种不同大细的地图有26X26，28X28，30X30 和32×32 协助物件，它可以帮助你完成游戏 内有280张地图可以玩 不同难度级别，应该满足不同人的需要。高手可以直接选择疯狂程度。 当完成正常区域，危险区域将被打开。完成危险区后，噩梦区域也会打开。在危险、噩梦区的敌人力量会大大增加。 快来下载吧! 超级坦克大战: iPhone: https://itunes.apple.com/cn/app/super-tank-battle/id507828762 iPad: https://itunes.apple.com/cn/app/super-tank-battle-hd/id526064033 想编辑自己的地图? 新版超级坦克大战: 坦克大决战 - 90年代 NES 小霸王经典 - 快下载吧! https://itunes.apple.com/cn/app/tank-super-wars-nes-90s-classic/id962978069 沙盒宇宙, 发展星系和成长倒不同星球的型态 我的梦幻宇宙 - myDream Universe iOS : https://apps.apple.com/cn/app/mydream-universe/id1447861806

873095450.name: Lenormand!
873095450.description: Discover why Tarot readers everywhere are branching out to Lenormand! Here you will find two versions of the Dondorf Lenormand deck: the first printing from 1873, as well as a printing from the second set of engraving plates in 1878. The images in Lenormand are simpler, more straightforward, and easier to interpret than Tarot. In Lenormand, cards take shades of meaning from the neighboring cards. A row of Lenormand cards can be read like a sentence. Learn card meanings while playing with the app! Named for a famous card reader from the time of the French Revolution, Mademoiselle Marie Anne Lenormand read cards for many historical figures. These 36 images came to be called the Petit Lenormand cards after Mademoiselle Lenormand had died. The Dondorf Lenormand is a classic historical deck. Printed in Germany, the deck was sold for sixty years and used in every country in Europe. This definitive deck is now available in pixels, re-tooled for the 21st Century by The Fool’s Dog. Intuitive, elegant interface is easy for beginners and experts Gorgeous full screen, high-resolution card images Full support for all current iOS devices Sophisticated journal Includes introduction and brief card meanings 12 spreads built in Design your own layout with Free Form Zoom in to enlarge card details Share reading via Facebook, email and Twitter Animated shuffle & cut Optional voice prompts Customize with your own card meanings & reading cloths Many adjustable settings Introduction and card meanings available in English only Learn about the future from a classic deck of the past, with the Dondorf Lenormand!

873538435.name: GoCamera – PlayMemories Mobile
873538435.description: GoCamera是功能强大的相机应用程序，可让您远程控制Sony PlayMemories Mobile相机。使用GoCamera通过自定义曝光设置拍摄精美的照片。拍摄后，轻松编辑并与朋友分享您的照片。 特征 远程控制Sony PlayMemories手机相机 放大和缩小场景 使用不同的拍摄模式，例如程序自动，光圈优先，快门优先和手动（取决于相机和固件） 控制曝光设置，例如曝光补偿（EV），ISO感光度，光圈和快门速度（取决于曝光模式） 调整白平衡预设 使用裁切，滤镜效果或模糊等功能编辑照片 通过iMe​​ssage，Facebook，Twitter等与您的朋友分享您最喜欢的时刻 请注意，GoCamera不支持捕获视频。 可靠性和用户体验 通过我们的最新更新，我们能够显着改善可靠性和用户体验。 GoCamera现在比以往更快。此外，我们用大量不同的Sony摄像机型号（例如QX10，QX100，Alpha 5100，Alpha 6000，HX400V等）测试了GoCamera。 设备支持 索尼PlayMemories移动相机列表：索尼a7，索尼a7S II，索尼a7R，索尼a7R II，索尼a7S，索尼a5000，索尼a5100，索尼av6000，索尼a6300，索尼a6500，索尼NEX-5R，索尼NEX-5T，索尼NEX-6，索尼HX60，索尼HX80，索尼HX90，索尼HX400，索尼WX500，索尼RX10 II，索尼RX10 III，索尼RX100 III，索尼RX100 IV，索尼RX100 V，索尼DSC-QX10，索尼DSC-QX30，索尼DSC-QX100，索尼ILCE-QX1。 索尼于2017年3月停止了PlayMemories Mobile界面。此日期之后发布的相机（例如Sony a7R III）可能与GoCamera不兼容。请阅读相机的用户手册或访问Sony的支持网站，以获取有关设备支持的更多信息。 请注意，某些设备需要从相机的内置应用商店中安装“智能远程嵌入式”服务才能启用WiFi连接。请遵守相机的手册。此外，作为第三方开发商，我们无法保证所有PlayMemories Mobile相机都支持设备，因为Sony可以自行决定限制第三方使用并更改界面设置。 法律 下载此应用程序即表示您同意我们的服务条款和隐私政策：www.caloon.co/legal 我们使用Creative Commons Attribution-NoDerivs 3.0 Unported许可下的Icons8中的图标。有关更多信息，请访问https://icons8.com

874200510.description: 发现50个引人入胜的昆虫视频，为孩子们！ 通过“视频触摸 - 昆虫”让您的孩子娱乐和学习！这款应用包含50个引人入胜的高清视频，让您的孩子以有趣互动的方式探索奇妙的昆虫世界。只需点击一只昆虫——如蝴蝶、蚂蚁、千足虫等——即可欣赏令人愉悦的10-20秒短片。观看蜜蜂从花朵中采集花蜜，蜘蛛编织它的网，或毛毛虫变成美丽的蝴蝶。 每种昆虫都有4个不同的视频，因此每次点击都会带来新的惊喜！ 主要特点： 21种语言的配音（见下文） 50个引人入胜的昆虫视频片段——非常适合好奇的幼儿 每种昆虫4个不同的视频——每次点击都有新鲜乐趣 与其他“视频触摸”应用无缝协作，带来更多学习冒险 立即下载，让您的孩子通过每次点击发现、学习和享受乐趣！ 支持的语言： 中文（简体）、英语、日语、韩语、俄语、法语、德语、西班牙语、意大利语、荷兰语、瑞典语、挪威语、丹麦语、芬兰语、阿拉伯语、捷克语、希伯来语、印地语、英语（UK）和英语（澳大利亚）。

874348017.name: Neonizer: Neon Photo Effect
874348017.description: Neonizer is a real-time camera that turns the world in front of your lens into glowing neon-sign art. Point your iPhone at anything — a building, a face, a houseplant — and watch its edges light up in vivid pink, cyan, and yellow neon. There's no "edit" step: the finished look is what you see in the viewfinder, so you can frame and light your shot live. ■ Features Real-time neon processing powered by OpenCV edge detection Three effect modes: – Line — traces subject outlines with glowing strokes – Rect — wraps detected regions in neon rectangles – Circle — highlights detected regions with glowing rings Night Mode — drops the background to pure black so only the neon glows Adjustable line thickness via slider Tap to take a photo, long-press to record video Built-in album to review your shots without leaving the app Share via the standard iOS share sheet (Mail, AirDrop, Messages, and more) ■ Try it on Night streets and signage for a cyberpunk look People for glowing line-art silhouettes Houseplants and small objects for sci-fi arcade icons Anything ordinary, made instantly "shareable" ■ Free, no ads Neonizer is a free indie project with no ads and no tracking. If you enjoy it, an optional "Support the developer" tip jar lives in Settings. Tips are completely voluntary and unlock no features or content. ■ Requirements iOS 17.0 or later. Optimized for the iPhone rear camera.

874789500.name: Smolov Squat Calculator
874789500.description: No more fiddling with spreadsheets and print outs at the gym. This app calculates the weights you should use, based on your one rep max, for the 3-week Smolov Jr. and 13-week Full Smolov Squat protocols. The app also makes it easy to keep track of where you are in the cycle. This Russian squat cycle has also been used by many for other lifts such as the bench press, shoulder press and deadlift with big jumps in strength. Smolov isn't for new lifters, but if you have some experience under your belt (like with 5/3/1, starting strength, 20 squat, etc.), then this may be a great lifting protocol for you.

875149504.name: Kiwaka故事
875149504.description: 你是否知道在一个古老的传说中萤火虫携有来自星星的光芒？… 我们的故事从 Kiwaka 开始，它是非洲丛林深处一处隐秘的小地方。那里住着有史以来最奇怪的四个生物。 在此互动书本中，你将跟随我们的朋友一起探寻，并点亮天空中的星星和揭示星座的古老奥秘。 此电子书将把您送到 Kiwaka 温暖愉快的夜晚，在那里有四个朋友正欢快地探索夜空。在这个神奇的学习冒险之旅中与它们相遇吧！ 特征 配乐：David Leon（艾美奖提名、屡获殊荣的作曲家）； 旁白：Diogo Morgado（仅限英语和葡萄牙语版本），曾在圣经史诗电影“Son of God”中饰演耶稣一角； 所有页面均为互动式和动画的。 语言：英语、德语、西班牙语、法语、意大利语、葡萄牙语、中文和日语。 你也可以玩我们的教育游戏 Kiwaka 并帮助四个朋友抓住萤火虫和学习关于星星和星座的知识。

875242534.name: 小小建筑工人
875242534.description: 小小建筑工人——让2-6岁的孩子享受建筑工地的乐趣！ 新增2个场景。驾驶扫路机以及卸下随车吊上的货物！ 在建筑工地上，孩子可以驾驶挖掘机、混合水泥、盖屋顶、操作起重机、驾驶扫路机或者粉刷房屋。这里有很多事情可以做呢！我们的小小建筑工人可以挖地、涂墙泥、填土、粉刷和混合水泥...他们需要孩子们的帮助哦！ 同时，他们还可以观察到正在发生的有趣的事情，因为每个建筑工地上总会有地方出错嘛。水管突然爆裂，水喷出来了，一个建筑工人掉入洞里，或者风把砖吹走了，因为水泥还没有干哩。 “小小建筑师”是为2-6岁、想要探索真正的小建筑工人世界的孩子们设计的第一个3D应用。所有的动画和功能都可以自动运行或者通过轻击控制，具体取决于孩子的年龄。 包括7个互动的场景，其中超过100个互动式动画和惊喜： 1. 操纵挖掘机、替卡车填土和修复水管。 2. 给房子涂上各种颜色的漆和卸载卡车。 3. 操作起重机和为一幢房子盖个新的屋顶。 4. 混合水泥和建造一堵真正的墙。 5. 操作一个大的水泥搅拌机和大面积地铺上混凝土。 6. 驾驶扫路机，清洁脏兮兮的路面。 7. 卸下随车吊上的货物，确保它准时离开。 图片精彩绝伦，动画超级棒，界面友好，没有文字，也没有App内购买项目。立即下载，即可开始建造！ 请同时看看我们为儿童设计的精采的应用程序： “爱畜动物园” - 是一本奇幻的故事书应用程序，用于iPad和iPhone。它拥有超过20只动物角色及美丽、有趣、互动的动画，必然受各岁数的孩子和动物爱好者的欢迎。 “晚安，小绵羊” - 是日常睡觉啦仪式用的完美应用程序，附可爱的动物、悦耳的音乐和精采的故事叙述。 “小狐狸音乐盒” - 是一本随唱歌谣集，3首歌曲便有超过100个互动元素，还有小狐狸音乐工作室，供您录制自己的歌曲。 如有遇到任何与应用程序有关的麻烦，或有任何疑问或意见，请不要犹豫，随时与我们联系： contact@foxandsheep.com。我们很乐意帮忙。请还告诉我们您的设备版本和iOS版本。 如需更多信息和支持，请访问我们的网站www.foxandsheep.com。 关于 Fox & Sheep： 我们是来自柏林的儿童 App 工作室，为 2-8 岁的儿童开发高品质的游戏。 同样身为父母，我们带着对我们产品的热情和心血工作着。我们为我们的 App 选择全世界顶尖的插画师和动画师，为了能开发最美的 App 呈献给孩子们，以及带给我们和你们的孩子更丰富多彩的生活。

876356250.name: AirBrowser - AirPlay browser
876356250.description: AirBrowser is the APP you need if you have got an Apple Tv!! Supported devices: iPhone (4s or greater), iPad (2 or greater) iPod touch 5th generation. Watch the video on http://www.airbrowser-app.com! Air Browser gives you a full desktop internet browser experience, but without a PC. All you need is an iOS device and an Apple TV (or a supported HDMI Cable). You will be able to surf the web, to watch streaming videos in full screen on your TV, to read newspapers and anything else you normally do with a standard PC or a Mac browser. Pinch to zoom, swipe gesture to navigate through the navigation history, an easy to use multi tab system, bookmarks and more. Air browser works fine with any web site included youtube and Facebook, fully supported with photos and videos upload, chat with friends and videos watching with fullscreen mode!! AirBrowser has a real responsive pointer, giving you a real desktop browsing experience, with all the mouse related effects that normally occurs on a PC web browser. Thanks to the “scale page to fit” feature, AirBrowser optimizes fonts on your TV to let reading more comfortable. Supported devices: iPhone (4s or greater), iPad (2 or greater) iPod touch 5th generation. Watch the video on http://www.airbrowser-app.com !

876395679.name: Verbole Russian
876395679.description: Conjugation and declension of Russian words, with their pronunciation Translation for most of the entries Basic Russian grammar Russian cursive letters Main features : Large database : more than 60 000 words Indication of stress accent for all forms Word search can be performed with Latin or Cyrillic letters, or by entering an inflected form A document allows user to look up words in texts, with morphological analysis. Flash Cards The app uses the built-in text-to-speech functionality of IOS : just tap on any form to hear its pronunciation. Dictionaries can be added to the app. The formats supported are StarDict and Babylon dictionaries - free bilingual Russian dictionaries are available on the internet in these formats. No internet connection required

877232946.name: Mobile Golf Tempo
877232946.description: Mobile Golf Tempo Training App allows any golfer to mimic the swing of the Pros, improving distance and accuracy, potentially making the need for bunkers obsolete! Mobile Golf Tempo is the best way to master long and short game with a smooth swing rhythm as well as putting distance control. Professional golfers regularly work their tempo so why not you? Teaching pros agree that consistent tempo is an important aspect of the golf swing. A very slow tempo is something golfers of all levels should avoid. This app allows golfers to establish the tempo of the tour pros and a fluid rhythm in order to add length to their shots, consistency across their game and distance control. The “Swing ratio” is the time it takes to complete the backswing as compared to the downswing. A swing ratio of 3:1 means the backswing is three times as long as the downswing. This swing ratio can vary across club selection or shot type. For example, many touring pros use a swing ratio of 3:1 for their driver with a ratio of 2.1:1 when making their putts. By simply reacting to visual, audial or vibrational signals delivered through your iPhone, you can begin your backswing, start your downswing, and make impact with the golf ball at precisely the correct tempo and timing. It’s just that simple! There is even and optional additional tone for golfers who utilize a swing trigger (any kind of move that takes place just before golfers start their swing) in their game. Visit our blog at http://www.mobile-golf-tempo.com/blog-in-english/ to learn to control distance in short game using Mobile Golf Tempo. For the demanding golfers, Mobile Golf Tempo allows them to change all parameters of the tempo. Features: Simple and advanced mode Possibility to create a WAV file containing audio sequences from your tempo to be played by your iPod mini for example The only tempo app fully configurable that allows slow tempo (useful for senior players) as well as extremely fast tempo like the faster pros on tour, and all in between One of the only tempo apps that allows you to break rules and experiment all you want: swing ratio can be changed from 1.00:1 to 4.25:1 Opportunity to have different tempos for each club (including the putter) Tempo is expressed in different ways, one of which is textual (too slow, slow, relax, animated, lively, fast, very fast, explosive and too fast) 7 preset tempos corresponding to the majority of touring pros Ability to adjust the human reaction time to the sound. So, you only have to react to the tones Ability to take into account the time of a possible swing trigger (ritual) Animation of the swing (driver, iron, full swing wedge, ¾ swing wedge, ½ swing wedge, ¼ swing wedges and putter), right-handed and left-handed. The movement of the golfer reflects your settings (e.g. the swing trigger and the human reaction time to sound). Possibility to select a random time between the sound sequences Metronome Vibrate mode Compatible with the Suunto G6 watch Languages: French, English and Spanish Train your tempo memory Learning mode Offline documentation with technical advices If you're not getting sound from Mobile Golf Tempo App, please check the "Mute" side switch located near the volume button. The reason why some apps (like Music) played sound and others didn't is because individual iOS apps can decide whether their audio should play regardless of the mute switch state. Many golf clubs prohibit the sounds of phones, and that's why the sound of Mobile Golf Tempo app does not play when you use side switch to mute the phone. This is a normal and standard feature, so please don't write negative comments for something that's absolutely logical!

Mobile Golf Tempo is the best way to master long and short game with a smooth swing rhythm as well as putting distance control. Professional golfers regularly work their tempo so why not you? Teaching pros agree that consistent tempo is an important aspect of the golf swing. A very slow tempo is something golfers of all levels should avoid. This app allows golfers to establish the tempo of the tour pros and a fluid rhythm in order to add length to their shots, consistency across their game and distance control. The “Swing ratio” is the time it takes to complete the backswing as compared to the downswing. A swing ratio of 3:1 means the backswing is three times as long as the downswing. This swing ratio can vary across club selection or shot type. For example, many touring pros use a swing ratio of 3:1 for their driver with a ratio of 2.1:1 when making their putts. By simply reacting to visual, audial or vibrational signals delivered through your iPhone, you can begin your backswing, start your downswing, and make impact with the golf ball at precisely the correct tempo and timing. It’s just that simple! There is even and optional additional tone for golfers who utilize a swing trigger (any kind of move that takes place just before golfers start their swing) in their game. Visit our blog at http://www.mobile-golf-tempo.com/blog-in-english/ to learn to control distance in short game using Mobile Golf Tempo. For the demanding golfers, Mobile Golf Tempo allows them to change all parameters of the tempo. Features: Simple and advanced mode Possibility to create a WAV file containing audio sequences from your tempo to be played by your iPod mini for example The only tempo app fully configurable that allows slow tempo (useful for senior players) as well as extremely fast tempo like the faster pros on tour, and all in between One of the only tempo apps that allows you to break rules and experiment all you want: swing ratio can be changed from 1.00:1 to 4.25:1 Opportunity to have different tempos for each club (including the putter) Tempo is expressed in different ways, one of which is textual (too slow, slow, relax, animated, lively, fast, very fast, explosive and too fast) 7 preset tempos corresponding to the majority of touring pros Ability to adjust the human reaction time to the sound. So, you only have to react to the tones Ability to take into account the time of a possible swing trigger (ritual) Animation of the swing (driver, iron, full swing wedge, ¾ swing wedge, ½ swing wedge, ¼ swing wedges and putter), right-handed and left-handed. The movement of the golfer reflects your settings (e.g. the swing trigger and the human reaction time to sound). Possibility to select a random time between the sound sequences Metronome Vibrate mode Compatible with the Suunto G6 watch Languages: French, English and Spanish Train your tempo memory Learning mode Offline documentation with technical advices If you're not getting sound from Mobile Golf Tempo App, please check the "Mute" side switch located near the volume button. The reason why some apps (like Music) played sound and others didn't is because individual iOS apps can decide whether their audio should play regardless of the mute switch state. Many golf clubs prohibit the sounds of phones, and that's why the sound of Mobile Golf Tempo app does not play when you use side switch to mute the phone. This is a normal and standard feature, so please don't write negative comments for something that's absolutely logical!

878642174.name: TV Cast Pro for Samsung TV
878642174.trackName: TV Cast Pro for Samsung TV
878642174.description: Watch any web video, online movie, livestream or live TV show on your Samsung Smart TV or Blu-ray Player. Enjoy the show on your big screen with the no#1 web video streamer. With Video & TV Cast for Samsung Smart TV you can browse the web and stream any web video, online movie, livestream or live TV show you want on your Samsung Smart TV. Mp4, m3u8, hls livestreams and also video-over-https are supported. There is no time limit at all! You can watch videos of 2 minutes or 2 hours or even more. Just open Video & TV Cast, navigate to a website and wait for the video link detection. The video link will appear below the browser. Tap it and the video will be sent to your big screen instantly! Streaming personal media from your device is also supported. You don't need to install a big media server like Plex or any other third party software. Important Notes To enable video casting, please open the Samsung App Store (Smart Hub) on your TV or Blu-ray Player, search for 'TV Cast' and install the receiver app. Please enter the IP address of your iPhone/iPad by using the number pad and up/down/left/right buttons on your Samsung TV Remote. Just enter the numbers, no need to press the enter key. iTunes movies and DRM-protected videos like Amazon Prime, Netflix, Hulu, Vudu, DirecTV, Xfinity, HBO Now are not supported! Please use the Remote Playbar for video control while browsing (see more info below). The app streams only the video part of a website and not the whole website content (No screen or tab mirroring!). Sometimes it is necessary to play the video on your iPad or iPhone first before it gets discovered by the app for streaming. It may also be neccessary to start casting multiple times until it works with specific videos. If a specific video is not working, please check the FAQ on the app startpage. If that does not help you, please drop us an email before leaving a negative comment on the App Store. We will try to add support for that website as soon as possible. PRO FEATURES Remote Playbar: Use the Playbar for advanced video control while browsing, including video scrubbing, forward, rewind, play, pause, stop. The playbar works on all Samsung Smart TVs and Blu-ray Players. Local Videos: Cast your camera roll videos from an iPhone or iPad. Supports mp4, m4v and mov videos that were saved to the camera roll via Apples SD-Card/USB Adapter, iTunes Desktop Software or third party apps. Ad-Blocker + No Sponsoring Ads: The Pro app version has no ads and the Ad-Blocker blocks ads & popups on most websites that you visit. You can update, enable/disable ad-blocking at any time in the settings. Bookmarks: Save unlimited website bookmarks. Synchronize and transfer them between different TV Cast apps and iOS devices by using backup and restore via iCloud. Desktop Mode: Change the browser user-agent and cloak your iPhone/iPad as a desktop PC to load the desktop website instead of the mobile website. Please note that this will NOT enable video casting on websites that serve Flash videos in desktop mode. Change Homepage: Set your personal homepage in the settings. Disclaimer: This app is not affiliated with Samsung or any other trademark mentioned here.

879908394.name: Starry sky Camera
879908394.description: This camera app is able to take pictures of a real starry sky. You can take stars of the first magnitude and stars of the second magnitude or less in good condition. If you have a device with a high-performance camera these days, you might even be able to capture the Milky Way, depending on the conditions. (Conditions include long exposure (e.g., 4 seconds or more) x 10 or more continuous shots, and keeping the ISO as low as possible while still achieving sufficient brightness.) You can also get the pictures processed through dozens or more kinds of image processing filter. To take pictures of the starry sky, you have only to (1)set your iPhone camera toward a starry sky on a tripod, (2)tap the star icon (star1, star2 or star3), (Star1 is recommended.) (3)release the shutter, and just wait a minute or so. Adjust the long exposure parameters using manual exposure depending on the results. For Star 1, select the brightest pixel for each pixel in the continuous shooting image to highlight the brightness of the stars in the dark night sky. Star 2 raises the tone of brightness according to the number of continuous shots and shoots brightly. Star 3 adds brightness to each pixel of the continuous shooting image and shoots very brightly. Even with the same number of exposures, the images are brightly combined in the low to high order of star 1, star 2, star 3. However, please note that the brightness of Star 3 tends to be saturated. The main features of this app are as follows. [Initial setting] (1) Camera position / library selection (setting screen) You can select the front camera and the rear camera. Also, if you select the library, you can import photos from the camera roll. (2) Shooting scene settings The following scenes (functions) can be set. (6) Camera shake correction function The camera shake correction function is useful for minute camera shake. Also, even if the star moves during shooting due to diurnal movement, the deviation is corrected and combined. (7) HDR (high dynamic range) function You can take multiple pictures with automatically changed exposure and combine them to take a picture with a pseudo-widened dynamic range. (8) Manual exposure setting function The shutter speed and ISO value can be manually set to any value within the range of device performance. [Camera function] Camera work is possible according to the contents set in the initial settings. You can also pinch in and out for digital zoom. The shutter also has a 2-second or 10-second timer to avoid camera shake when tapping. These can be selected by pressing and holding the shutter icon. [List display function] Photos taken with this app are stored in this app at the same time as they are stored in the camera roll, and can be displayed in a list with shooting date and time information on the list display screen. You can delete the tapped image by tapping Select, selecting the image, and tapping the trash can icon. [Image processing function] Tap the displayed image to display the filter list for image processing. There are about 70 types of filters such as brightness adjustment, contrast, blur, sharpening, sepia, monochrome, edge detection, sketch, etc.
879908394.fullDescription: This camera app is able to take pictures of a real starry sky. You can take stars of the first magnitude and stars of the second magnitude or less in good condition. If you have a device with a high-performance camera these days, you might even be able to capture the Milky Way, depending on the conditions. (Conditions include long exposure (e.g., 4 seconds or more) x 10 or more continuous shots, and keeping the ISO as low as possible while still achieving sufficient brightness.) You can also get the pictures processed through dozens or more kinds of image processing filter. To take pictures of the starry sky, you have only to (1)set your iPhone camera toward a starry sky on a tripod, (2)tap the star icon (star1, star2 or star3), (Star1 is recommended.) (3)release the shutter, and just wait a minute or so. Adjust the long exposure parameters using manual exposure depending on the results. For Star 1, select the brightest pixel for each pixel in the continuous shooting image to highlight the brightness of the stars in the dark night sky. Star 2 raises the tone of brightness according to the number of continuous shots and shoots brightly. Star 3 adds brightness to each pixel of the continuous shooting image and shoots very brightly. Even with the same number of exposures, the images are brightly combined in the low to high order of star 1, star 2, star 3. However, please note that the brightness of Star 3 tends to be saturated. 879915554.name: Midiflow
879915554.description: Midiflow allows you to send MIDI from app to app in a similar way to what you already do with audio. That way, you can sync apps with each other or send MIDI parts from a sequencer app to different synth apps. You can also route the MIDI from your keyboard to apps and assign different key zones to them. Different settings can be stored as a preset, recalled later and inserted into another preset. Furthermore, all MIDI transfer can be monitored in order to find problems or just to learn what MIDI is doing (normally) behind the scenes. Important news: There is a full documentation on the Midiflow website now! HOW DOES IT WORK? Midiflow allows you to create multiple routings. Each routing receives MIDI data on its source and sends it to its destination. The selectable sources and destinations include your CoreMIDI compatible MIDI interface and other apps if they provide a virtual MIDI port. You can also create custom ports that can be used by other apps to receive data from Midiflow or send data to it. A routing also has a modifier which allows you to filter data or modify it. That way, you can transpose notes, limit them to a key range, change the MIDI channel of the incoming data, etc. (see the feature list below). LIST OF FEATURES + MIDI clock – specify tempo and your apps will be in sync + Channel filtering and remapping + Velocity filtering – a routing is only active for notes in a given velocity range + Note shift – shift all notes by a given number of half-tone steps + Note remapping – shift each note individually + Velocity remapping – apply a velocity curve, transform to fixed velocity, or specify the map value by value. In the latter case, you can also export the mapping to the clipboard, edit it in another app like Apple Numbers, and paste it back in Midiflow + Filtering out Clock or dividing the tempo into subdivisions + Filtering out SysEx + Connect to other iPads/iPhones via Bluetooth MIDI (iOS8 or higher) + Save a configuration as a preset, which can be recalled later or inserted into another preset + Custom virtual MIDI ports, which can be selected in other apps as a source or destination + Control aspects of Midiflow via MIDI. For example, select presets or control the clock with any MIDI command + Launch your synth apps from Midiflow (works with an increasing number of apps) + Sharing your configurations ADDITIONAL FEATURES (available as an In-app purchase) + Filtering and remapping of controllers – transform (a) the controller type, e.g. from CC1 to pitch-bend or note value to CC1, and (b) transform the value in several ways: as a linear remapping from an input range to an output range, as a curve, or as a value by value list. In the latter case, you can also export the mapping to the clipboard, edit it in another app like Apple Numbers, and paste it back in Midiflow. This allows you to create very sophisticated remappings. + Controller conditions – adjust your routings depending on other MIDI messages. This allows you to create sophisticated behavior within your setup by switching routings on and off. DOES MIDIFLOW WORK WITH MY SYNTH APPS? Midiflow works with every app that has a correct MIDI implementation. In the best case, it has an own virtual MIDI port and can be configured so that it receives MIDI only on that port. Unfortunately, some apps don't have that, but can at least be restricted to one MIDI channel. In that case, you can send to that channel on the global MIDI port "Network Session 1". If you can't select a channel either, then the app won't work with Midiflow. There is a tutorial video on www.midiflow.com that explains this in more detail.

881263940.name: The Jacobson Flare
881263940.description: The Jacobson Flare Version 2.0 Since 1987, the unique application of The Jacobson Flare has eliminated the imprecise aspects of landing an airplane, otherwise unchanged since the end of World War 1 in 1918. Everything else in aviation has advanced, but NOT landing training. Historically, the manual landing manoeuvre has remained indeterminate. Conventional flare techniques have involved an inconsistent, critical estimation of height above the landing surface and are subject to a number of variable factors, summarised as aircraft, pilot and environmental. The Jacobson Flare is the first and only quantifiable, universal and consistent landing technique in the history of aviation. To land an airplane consistently well, a pilot should be able to explain the following five questions: 1. Where to aim? 2. How to aim? 3. When to flare? 4. How much to flare? 5. How fast to flare (flare rate)? The Jacobson Flare App for the iPad, originally featured in June 2014 on the Australian App Store in ‘Best New Apps’, answers all five applying, clearly and simply, known principles and facts that enable a pilot at any level of competence and experience to finally and fully understand HOW to make safer and more consistent landings, in any airplane type. The noted increase in pilot competence and confidence is breathtaking. The Jacobson Flare App for iPad V2.0 Professionally designed, the Jacobson Flare app for iPad is so much more than the simple equivalent of a 330-page book; interactive and inclusive, it totally replaces and greatly enhances successive and widely acclaimed presentations of the original 1987 Jacobson Flare paper, “Where to Flare” and other associated files. This updated Version 2.0 of the Jacobson Flare app explores the where, when & how involved in landing an airplane in TWO DISTINCT PRESENTATIONS: Designed in LANDSCAPE as an extensively illustrated comprehensive presentation, with accompanying text; and The Jacobson Flare TREATISE, now re-worked in Landscape and partly illustrated, designed as an e-book, for uninterrupted reading and comprehension of the complete text. These are best viewed in landscape on at least the screen size of an iPad Mini OR larger iPhone. Graphically enhanced HD videos of various airplane types using the same consistent and quantified technique, at a diverse range of locations, highlight the Jacobson Flare app for iPad as a perfect solution to a serious long-term problem for world aviation. Thirty-five years of research and development are reflected in the intuitive design, fine production and attention to detail - just some of the hallmarks of this stylish presentation. Summary The Jacobson Flare has been adopted enthusiastically by thousands of pilots in 65 countries. The convenient digital format on iPad has accelerated industry awareness and acceptance and offers predictable and consistently better landings for those individual pilots, at ANY level of experience, who are always seeking to improve their skill set. Perhaps the three best descriptions come from highly experienced professional pilots: “the greatest single advance in flying training in many, many years and represents simple unassailable aerodynamic logic”; “this is probably what we have all been trying to do all these years”; and “this has the elegant simplicity of the safety pin”. Website: www.jacobsonflare.com Email: info@jacobsonflare.com Captain David M Jacobson MAP FRAeS: +61 419 346 336 The Jacobson Flare

882579368.name: 紫微西经
882579368.description: 通过对紫微app的研发和扩展，人们现在可以利用天地人紫微app中的天盘，地盘和人盘，来查看他们一生的命盘。这个包含中国占星术所有知识的app不仅让您了解和发现自己，达到自我价值的实现，同时也为您规划你的未来提供了适合的工具。 天盘，地盘和人盘分别代表一个人一生中的不同时期。 天盘反应着你与生俱来的个性。在早期的童年岁月，人们都是先从他们的父母学会和了解到这个世界是如何运转的，并通过使用阳的能量来开发自己的思维。而这个天盘是每个人灵魂的必经之路，这里包含了人一生的的使命和可能将会遇到的障碍。 地盘反应着你后天的个性。 地盘发生的时间是从天盘成熟后， 人生开始就会受到阴的能量如情绪或杂念的影响而产生的。 地盘里包括着这段时间个人才华的发展性和局限性。 人盘是人到了中年时经过天盘和地盘综合之后，阴阳能量得到一个平衡的过程。这时，有些人会觉得还没有发现自我存在的意义， 但如果有的话，那这个人生就是圆满。这个过程也确定了这个人下辈子的天盘。 Supported Languages: English Simplified Chinese (简体中文) Traditional Chinese (繁體中文)

882677998.name: FocalPoint
882677998.description: One click to make focus on one thing only. An app made to enhance your concentration. With just one click anywhere in your workspace on any window, all other windows and objects will be blurred instantly with a translucent mask. You can easily drag, move, and resize your focused window and the mask will always follow. Switching to a different focus window and clearing the mask also only takes one click. Compared with working in full-screen mode, FocalPoint is a better way to help you concentrate on one task because it also gives you convenient access to your other windows. All your distractions will be out of sight, but still within the reach of a single mouse click. features: v2.01 enhance your concentration by masking out distractions just one click to active, switch windows, and deactivate significantly improve your efficiency works on unlimited Spaces the color and transparency of the mask can be fully customized the mask will follow automatically while of macOS Mojave. interface color mode switched accordingly bug fixed: About dialog box font color under the dark mode of macOS Mojave bug fixed: More Apps by dragonBTV link works again under macOS Mojave 10.14 performance improvements for macOS 10.14 Mojave v2.72 -> v3.00 Any Mac (Apple Silicon, Intel) version for macOS Big Sur interface fine-tuning for dark mode v3.00 -> v3.10 status menu bar icon not only matches macOS dark mode but also the wallpaper light/dark setting bug fixed: purchased option can not be restored automatically interface and menu modified More by dragonBTV menu updated Tips: FocalPoint is very straightforward to use. Just click the window, panel, dialog, app, or whatever else you would like to work with and concentrate on, and all other windows will be masked off. If you resize or move the window you're concentrating on, the mask will adjust automatically. Clicking another window while the mask is on will make the app concentrate on that window instead, and mask all others. Clicking anywhere other than a window (e.g. desktop, dock menu, status menu, etc.) while the mask is on will turn off the mask. The mask will also turn off if you close or minimize the window you're working with. The color and transparency of your mask can be fully customized. You may also set the mask to be cleared automatically while mousing over the menu and dock menu. The Preferences panel can be reached from both the app’s main menu and the dock menu.

883994808.description: ◆简单、 容易理解的Widget。 ◇只需选择在地图上，你可以看到世界各地的天气。 ◆轻松查看世界各地的天气，时间，时间差。 ◇美丽的动画和渐变颜色。 ◆如果天气发生变化，通知您。 ◇支持iOS/iPadOS 13 Dark Mode。 ◆◇ 可以下载免费软件 " Fine° " ◆◇ ▼功能： Widget ・通知中心，显示在通知点气象信息。 ・您可以从默认和深色中选择Widget的背景颜色。 ・支持折叠模式。 ・通过3D Touch/Haptic Touch功能用力按下App的图标的话，能够快速确认Widget。 通知功能 ・如果天气发生变化，通知您。 ・通过3D Touch/Haptic Touch功能用力按下通知的话，会出现美妙的动画让您确认详细情报。 ・对于没有装载3D Touch/Haptic Touch功能的机型，可以通过下拉通知菜单点击查看进行确认。 ・通知点可以通过App设定进行更改。 iMessage ・当前所在地的天气可以通过信息进行发送。 ・您可以发送静止图像和动画图像。 显示地图 ・在地图上显示天气图标。 ・您可以显示天气的地方在哪里长按在地图上。 ・天气和温度显示动画。 ・您可以自定义动画颜色、 时间和半径。 屏幕的天气预报 ・美丽的动画取决于天气。 ・温度、 时间、 时区、 湿度、 风速和风向。 ・你可以查看美丽渐变早上、 中午、 傍晚和晚上。 ・您可以查看在日出或日落的时候。 ・你可以查看天气预报每 3 个小时。 ・你可以在一周内查看天气预报。 ・可以同时显示多个点。 （iPhone 是 2 点。 iPad 是 4 点。） 点列表 在美丽的色彩渐变中可见的注册点的列表。 您可以添加点 可以添加的点是无限的。

884892027.name: 三省堂国語辞典 第七版
884892027.trackName: 三省堂国語辞典 第七版
884892027.description: 「三省堂国語辞典 第七版」は、三省堂より出版されている「新語に強い国語辞典『三国（サンコク）』の最新版」を収録した電子辞典アプリケーションです。 ベースとなる「三省堂国語辞典 第七版」は、新聞・雑誌・書籍・放送・インターネットなどから実例を収集した「生きた国語辞典」です。言葉を探すだけでなく、実例に基づいた豊富な用例をアプリに搭載された強力な用例検索機能で瞬時に見つけることができます。 大変好評をいただいている「大辞林」と同じインデックス表示を搭載しているので「言葉との出会い」を楽しむことができます。また、インデックスには「難読語」を収録しているので、読むのが難しい言葉を覚えるのに最適です。 言葉に難しい漢字が含まれていても、手書き文字認識エンジン「楽ひら®」を搭載しているので、手書き入力で簡単に調べることができます。 解説文は美しい縦組で表示されます。ピンチ操作で拡大表示すれば、難しい漢字も確実に確認することができます。 もちろん「なぞってジャンプ®」も搭載しているので、解説の中に含まれる知らない言葉、興味を引く言葉を指でなぞって簡単にジャンプすることができます。 インストール後のサイズもおよそ70MBと非常にコンパクトです。使用時にネットワークに接続する必要はなく、オフラインで安心してお使いいただけます。 主な機能は以下の通りです。 物書堂独自のレイアウトエンジンによる高速表示 前方／後方／完全一致検索 見出／慣用句／用例検索 パターン検索 手書き検索 インデックス機能（すべて／五十音／分野／慣用句／難読語／社会常識語／書き分け注意／付録 付録（序文／この辞書のきまり／略語表／動詞活用表／形容詞活用表／形容動詞活用表／助動詞活用表／現代仮名遣い／ローマ字のつづり方） なぞってジャンプ®機能 コピー&ペースト（長押しでコピーすることができます） 項目内検索 スワイプによる前後の項目の表示 ブックマーク機能（日付や見出しでのソート、自由な並べ替え） iCloudを使ったブックマークの同期 表示履歴および検索履歴 3D Touchでクイックアクション 3D TouchでPeekとPop iPadにも対応したユニバーサルアプリ iPadのSlide OverとSplit Viewに対応 Retinaディスプレイに対応 インターフェースのカラー変更 検索画面を引っぱって消去 クリップボード検索 他のアプリからの検索 カスタムアクション（他のアプリ上での検索） 「大辞林」「角川類語新辞典」など、他の物書堂アプリとの相互連携機能 VoiceOverによる解説文の読み上げ コンテンツについて ◎ 三省堂国語辞典 第七版 生きのよい国語辞典『三国（サンコク）』の全面改訂版 カタカナ語から生活のことばまで約4千語を追加 シンプルで平易な語釈によって現代語を活写する 類書にない項目(「スイスロール」等)や最新の知見(新語・新用法の発生・普及年代を示す、「銀ぶら」の民間語源を正す)も満載 話しことばに〔話〕のラベルを新表示 知らないと困る社会常識語約3千2百を新たに選定 項目数約82,000 「楽ひら」はパナソニック株式会社の登録商標です。

885347877.description: Speed​​o的GPS是全球定位系统车速表和行车电脑在一个应用程序中的花哨和独特的组合。 买GPS Speed​​o的，当你得到了什么 很多伟大的功能内置。 Speed​​o的全球定位系统收集所有必要之旅/路由统计信息。刚刚启动的应用程序和Speed​​o的GPS会自动记录您的地理数据（经纬度），速度，平均速度，启动时间，运行时间，距离，altidute等等。 使用测速仪应用在你的车，你的自行车，在火车或飞机，或当你走路或漫步。该应用程序将帮助你记录你旅途中的所有nessecary数据。 无广告 在应用程序中没有广告，我保证！ 通用应用程序 一次购买，并用它在你的iPhone和iPad。高分辨率图形的Retina Display（的iPhone4，iPhone 5（S）和新的iPad。 HUD 平视显示器 - 这个很酷的功能也可用。只是使HUD并把你的iPhone或iPad上的挡风玻璃下。该装置项目目前的速度到挡风玻璃上。所以，你不再是分散向前看的注意力，并拥有一切在视线内。 方向 该视图适应iPhone的方向。 GPS导航与地图显示 你曾经有切换到地图（卫星或混合视图）的可能性，所以你看你在哪里或在那里你会去。 实时统计 获取有关速度，平均速度，海拔高度，平均高度图形化的统计数据。 导出数据 通过电子邮件或iTunes文件共享导出所有记录的数据。 （CSV，XML，KML，GPX）和分析你的Mac或PC上的数据。 请注意： 全球定位系统的使用将大大降低设备的电池使用寿命。其推荐使用的充电器。 GPS是不是总是由于设备硬件传感器的局限性准确。 看到的是需要数据连接的地图。 请确保您已启用的应用程序的位置服务。 启用它 - 设置>常规>定位服务 视频： iPhone：http://youtu.be/YdOuA482SyQ iPad的：http://youtu.be/It5axbiohTs HUD：http://youtu.be/xniJyVQFmSQ

885404547.name: Meridian Inside for iOS
885404547.description: ‘Meridian Inside’ application was created by integrating ’12 Main Meridian’, ‘8 Extra Meridians’ and ’12 Meridian Divergences’, while applying it to the 3D human body model with ‘Main Acupuncture Point’. It is an application that can check the flow of the meridian of Asian medicine, which is the only one in the world now. You can check the location, flow, and contents of a total of 32 meridians. This product does not have complete text descriptions of ‘Main Acupuncture Points’, ‘Extra acupoints’, and ‘Tung ’s family acupunture point.’ This product does not have ’12 meridian sinews’, ’12 meridian regions’, and ’12 skin’ in this product yet. Easily zoom in and out with multi-touch so you can see the exact location of the ‘ Meridian and collateral’ itself and we add the “drive button bar” so easliy check the what you want. ’12 Main Meridian’, ‘8 Extra Meridians’ and ’12 Meridian Divergences’, can be grasped at the same time, and can be compared with ‘Main Acupuncture Point’. Main Acupuncture Point -> 12 Main Acupuncture Point, Governor Vessel (GV) Acupuncture Point, Conception Vessel(CV) Acupuncture Point.. - Please refer to ‘Acupoints’ application. For Main Acupuncture Points (such as 12 Main Acupuncture Point, Governor Vessel (GV) Acupuncture Point, Conception Vessel(CV) Acupuncture Point, lung, large intestine, etc.), refer to ‘Acupoints’ application. For Meridian and collateral (12 meridians, 14 meridians, eight extra meridians, twelve meridian divergences, twelve meridian sinews, twelve cutaneous regions, etc.) please refer to ‘Meridian Inside’ application. For Extra acupuncture points, please refer to ‘Extra Acupoints’ application. For Tung ’s family acupunture(In korean called as Dongssihyeol) (Dongssi, Master tung), refer to ‘Master Tung Acupoint’ application. This product does not have complete text descriptions of Main Acupuncture Points, extra acupoint, and Tung ’s family acupunture point. This product does not have 12 meridian sinews, 12 meridian regions, or 12 skin in this product yet. Meet our(verderoot, acumonster, medimonster) various products (Meridian, Meridian Inside, Master Tung, Extra-Acupuncture Point, Combination Point, Hand Acupuncture, Foot Acupoint, Head Acupuncture, etc.) look. www.verderoot.com www.acumonster.com

886650038.description: 完整版：农场 + 五大洲 - 带有内置购买设置的免费版本同样可供下载 ** “全部找到它们：寻找动物 ”是一个针对2至8岁儿童的游戏，引导他们在相应的自然环境（农场、草原、沙漠等等）中发现不同种类的动物。 以动物为主题的最完整的教育游戏 **** 来自6大洲的192种动物 7种语言显示名称 叫声、图画、卡片、照片，还有现在的视频！ 超过200条的音频评论 这是一个游戏：寻找动物、给他们拍照、创建拼图、赢得奖励等等。 通过多种多样的活动来探索动物世界 **** 走遍世界来寻找动物并赢取动态卡片。 拍摄照片并听你最喜爱动物的相关信息。 在夜晚来临前找到所有的动物…或者借助灯光在黑夜中找到它们。 用你拍的照片创建拼图（4、6、12、24、42块）。 玩照片问答并赢取相册中的新图片。 寻找摄影师：72段视频等你去发现！ 当然，你还可以在不同相册中找到你所有的卡片和照片，并且可以打印它们！ “全部找到它们”系列的共同特点 **** 为2至8岁儿童设计的游戏。 口语辅导及训练（汉语/普通话、英语）。 简单操作，没有广告。 不同语言的启蒙：多种语言描述动物名称（汉语/普通话、英语、法语、德语、西班牙语、日语）。 每一部分都不同（有不同的场景可用，每一部分的动物及定位都不一样）。 可以打印相册。 教育意义 **** 学习语言 发现外语 保持专注和细心 解析拼图 农场动物 **** 蜜蜂,驴,小绵羊,鸭子,猫,马,山羊,狗,猪,公鸡,火鸡,青蛙,长耳猫头鹰,兔子,羊,鹅,喜鹊,小马驹,母鸡,小鸡,狐狸,老鼠,乌龟,奶牛 非洲动物 **** 狮子,貂狸,母狮,猎豹,鬣狗,鸵鸟,奥卡狓,大象,斑马,牛羚,长颈鹿,犀牛,河马,鳄鱼,瞪羚,扭角林羚,单峰驼,耳廓狐,眼镜蛇,大羚羊,大猩猩,黑猩猩,狒狒,火烈鸟 亚洲动物 **** 老虎,熊猫,红熊猫,大象,犀牛,红猩猩,长鼻猴,日本鹤,雪豹,云豹,骆驼,牦牛,食鱼鳄,马来貘,亚洲水牛,穿山甲,孔雀,椰子熊,狞猫,犀鸟,叶猴,蟒蛇,眼镜猴 大洋洲动物 **** 针鼹,几维鸟,蝙蝠,鹤鸵,朱鹮,螃蟹,绿龟,座头鲸,海豚,儒艮,鬼蝠魟,海狗,巨蜥,湾鳄,袋鼠,鸸鹋,袋熊,袋獾,树袋熊,袋貂,鸭嘴兽,伞蜥,澳洲野狗,大白鲨 北美洲动物 **** 美洲野马,美洲野牛,郊狼,响尾蛇,秃鹫,草原犬鼠,走鹃,叉角羚,黑尾长耳大野兔,灰熊,驼鹿,浣熊,臭鼬,美洲狮,白头海雕,盘羊,雪羊,狼獾,北极熊,北极狐,雪鸮,海豹 南美洲动物 **** 羊驼,神鹫,眼镜熊,毛丝鼠,大食蚁兽,水豚,犰狳,鬃狼,鬣蜥,凯门鳄,兔豚鼠,美洲鸵鸟,水蟒,美洲豹,巨嘴鸟,金刚鹦鹉,长鼻浣熊,狮面狨,虎猫,亚马逊河豚,树懒,红眼树蛙,美洲红鹮,蜘蛛猿 要想获得更多信息，请访问http://cn.find-them-all.com

Getting started video available: http://youtu.be/NGuF4rfqt5k Features: "New" body shape slider from skinny to hourglass female models for great poses. "New" muscle structure model(black and white and color) "New" Seven hair styles help with visualization. Image Based Lighting (IBL) for stunning visuals. 889580711.name: MP3 Audiobook Player Pro
889580711.description: MP3 Audiobook Player is the easiest and most convenient app for listening to audiobooks in MP3, MP4, AWB, OPUS, OGG, FLAC, AWB, M4B, M4A formats on your iPhone, iPod Touch or iPad! The app does not feature any audiobooks, but only plays your own audio files ••• The purpose of this app is to make listening to audiobooks in different formats easy and convenient! There are lots of websites with all kinds of audiobooks dubbed by professional actors and enthusiasts. Most of such audiobooks are distributed as folders with multiple audiofiles in different formats. I'm, the author of the app, listen to audiobooks all the time. Therefore, I did my best to make MP3 Audiobook Player a tool that has everything necessary to make this process intuitive and convenient. Plays audiobooks in MP3, MP4, OPUS, OGG, FLAC, AWB, M4B, M4A formats (without DRM protection). Adjustable playback quality (0.5x to 5.0x). Boost sound ( for audiobooks with low volume ) The book cover is loaded from an image file in the book’s folder or from an embedded image from an audio file. Automatically saves the current playback position for all audiobooks. Supports CarPlay and integrations with over 50 other car models from Ford, GM, Mazda, BMW, Jaguar, Landrover and many more Jump to any file (can be enabled in settings). Supports standard headphone controls. Supports Apple Watch. Playback control from the Control Center and Block screen. A sleep timer with adjustable sleep periods or sleep after the end of the current chapter. Possibility to add/remove books through iTunes and from the computer via Wi-Fi Support WebDav for adding audiobooks directly from Explorer on PC or from Finder on MacOS If you enjoy MP3 Audiobook Player, we would be glad if you consider writing a review.
